You are interested in the position as Fullstack Developer (f/m/d) at Inverto GmbH
?

On Instaffo, you can apply for this and other jobs with ease. Create your profile in under 2 minutes and start the application process with just a few clicks.

Requirements

Please note that this position requires work authorization for Germany
.

Language: English - Fluent (C1), German - Fluent (C1)

A university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
At least 5 years of professional experience in full stack development with C#, ideally including hands-on experience with Blazor.
Strong practical expertise in C#/.NET, Blazor, Entity Framework, T-SQL, and REST APIs.
Experience in component-based UI architecture, responsive design, and creating intuitive user workflows.
Intermediate level of AI affinity, including experience with AI integrations or a strong willingness to grow into this field.
Conceptual thinking combined with flexibility, enthusiasm for new challenges, and a strong team-oriented mindset.

Activities

We need you to develop modern user interfaces in Blazor Server, building reusable components and ensuring consistent design patterns. You will implement and maintain business logic and security concepts in C#/.NET, ensuring our applications remain robust, secure, and high-performing. Integrate databases and external services like SQL Server and REST APIs, and implement AI integrations for our internal customers. Conduct code reviews, write unit and integration tests, manage error handling and logging, and continuously optimize the performance of our solutions.

Team

You will be joining a motivated IT team that offers a professional environment with individual development opportunities. From day one, you will take on responsibility and contribute directly to real products and practical solutions.

About The Company

Inverto is one of the leading procurement and supply chain management consultancies in the world. Backed by the power of BCG, we’ve grown from a successful European consultancy into a global company with a distinct offering. Our Business Services Teams play a critical role in enabling our business, driving continuous improvement, and shaping how we scale. Here, you can use your expertise to make a meaningful impact from within, taking on responsibility from day one and seeing the difference your work makes. As we continue to grow, so will your opportunities, in an environment that supports your development and empowers you to grow as we grow. There’s never been a better time to join Inverto and be part of what comes next.

jobs.title: AI Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About Us

Avanade is a global leader in digital, cloud, and AI‑driven solutions. As a joint venture between Microsoft and Accenture, we are the world’s largest consulting company fully focused on Microsoft technologies.

We help our clients design, build, and scale innovative solutions across Cloud, Applications, Data & AI, and Security, based on a strong #PeopleFirst culture.

Your Role

As an AI Software Engineer (Full stack, Frontend, Backend)
, you design, develop, and integrate AI
‑ enabled and Generative AI
‑ powered solutions
into modern applications.

You work hands‑on across the full stack while applying AI technologies to enhance user experiences, automate processes, and deliver measurable business value.

Depending on your experience, you may also lead small development teams, mentor colleagues, and contribute to solution design and technical decision
‑ making
.

You collaborate closely with product owners, designers, architects, and other engineers as part of multidisciplinary delivery teams.

Your Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure full‑stack applications
Integrate Generative AI capabilities into applications and development workflows
Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI agents to support automation and improved user interaction
Implement AI‑driven features using modern frameworks, APIs, and services
Collaborate with designers, product owners, and fellow developers to deliver high‑quality software
Participate across the entire software lifecycle, from requirements analysis to production deployment and support
Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested code aligned with best practices
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues across applications and AI components
Stay up to date with emerging AI technologies and actively contribute to continuous improvement

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years of professional experience in software or full‑stack development
Hands‑on experience using AI and Generative AI tools in application development
Proven experience designing and deploying Generative AI agents or AI‑powered features
Strong experience with front‑end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Solid backend/API development experience with Python, .NET Core, Node.js
Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g. SQL Server, Cosmos DB)
Understanding of containers and container orchestration
Experience with Azure or other major cloud platforms
Solid understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and DevOps practices
Strong problem‑solving skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset
Fluency in German and English are a mandatory requirement

Qualifications

Nice to Have

Experience leading or mentoring development teams
Familiarity with Azure OpenAI, Copilot, AI orchestration frameworks, or agent frameworks
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud‑native architectures
Background in consulting or customer‑facing project delivery

What Sets You Apart

Strong interest in applying AI to real‑world business problems
Hands‑on, solution‑oriented mindset
Ability to explain complex technical topics in a clear and structured way
High level of ownership, curiosity, and continuous‑learning attitude
Comfortable working in multidisciplinary and international teams

What We Offer

Opportunity to work for the Microsoft Global Alliance Partner of the Year
Access to extensive learning and certification programs, including AI and cloud technologies
Collaboration with experienced architects, AI specialists, and engineers globally
Clear career paths toward Senior AI Developer, Technical Lead, or AI Architect
Competitive, performance‑based compensation aligned with your experience and location
Compensation varies depending on role, location, experience, and skill set.
We place great importance on performance-based and competitive remuneration and, depending on your experience and qualifications, offer you an attractive compensation package.

Learn More About Some Of Our Benefits Here.

The Perfect Place to Work

More than 60,000 professionals, 26 countries, and one universe — that’s Avanade. No matter the digital challenge, we find the solution within the Microsoft ecosystem. Because one thing is clear: we come from good stock. Accenture LLP and Microsoft Corporation brought us into being in the year 2000. Naturally, we skillfully combine the best of both worlds.

If you decide to contribute your skills and individual talents at Avanade, you will be rewarded with unique experiences, unlimited learning opportunities, and ambitious growth.

And while we continue to invest in our diverse and inclusive culture — becoming even more innovative and creative along the way — we ensure that our clients benefit from our technological innovations and that our communities thrive. You will become part of a smart team that supports, encourages, guides you, and relies on your expertise. The perfect start at a company founded to implement mission‑critical, leading technology solutions while also striving to improve the way people work, interact, and live.

Do What Matters

We believe that inclusive and diverse teams can overcome any challenge — if you face challenges with passion and courage, you are exactly right with us. Your application is welcome regardless of your background, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender. With us, you can simply be yourself. Diversity in all its forms is close to our hearts and a core part of Avanade’s culture.

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du konzipierst und verantwortest Ende-zu-Ende-Teststrategien über alle Ebenen hinweg – Unit-, Integrations-, System-, UI-, Stress- und Performance-Tests – für unsere medizinischen Softwareprodukte.
Du baust und entwickelst Test-Harnesses und CI-Pipelines weiter, die Regressionen früh erkennen, stabil und skalierbar laufen und unseren C++-Desktop-, .NET- und modernen Web-Stacks schnelles, verlässliches Feedback liefern.
Du planst, implementierst und analysierst Last- und Performance-Tests, identifizierst Engpässe und Stabilitätsrisiken und treibst gemeinsam mit den Entwicklerteams messbare Qualitätsverbesserungen voran.
Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Architektur und Produktmanagement zusammen, agierst als Qualitäts-Gewissen des Teams und verankerst testgetriebene "Shift-Left"-Engineering-Praktiken.
Du nutzt AI-Agents und Tools wie Claude Code gezielt, um Tests zu generieren, zu pflegen und zu triagieren, und baust wiederverwendbare Automatisierungs-Skills und Workflows für die gesamte QA-Community auf.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung auf Senior-Level mit tiefem Verständnis für mehrschichtige Testframeworks sowie erprobte Praxis in Last- und Performance-Tests, idealerweise in regulierten oder sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen.
Exzellenter Studienabschluss in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studium mit sehr guten Noten.
Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in mindestens einer Sprache wie C#, Java, Python oder TypeScript; Praxis mit modernen Test-Tools (z. B. Ranorex, Playwright, Cypress), Versionsverwaltung und CI/CD (z. B. GitLab CI), ISTQB oder gleichwertige Zertifizierungen ist ein Plus.
Nachweislich effektiver Einsatz von AI in QA-Workflows; idealerweise Erfahrung mit Claude Code oder ähnlichen agentischen Coding-Tools (Agents, Skills, Workflows) sowie mit AI-Pipelines, Test Harnesses und Context Engineering.
Verhandlungssicherheit Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift, starke Problemlösungsfähigkeit, Innovationsfreude, ausgeprägte Proaktivität, unternehmerisches Mindset und hohe Qualitätsansprüche im Sinne einer modernen, patientenorientierten Healthcare-IT.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Entwicklung: Unsere Inhouse-Academy und unser Portfolio aus externen Kooperationspartnern unterstützen Dich in Deiner Weiterentwicklung.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV u. V. M. Für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

jobs.title: Solution Architect – AI Voice Backend (w/m/d) - Azure, hands on experience in designing AI/LLM-based products, Terraform
jobs.description:
Project description

Our client is advancing its in-vehicle voice assistant into an intelligent, AI-powered companion. Since 2024, large-language-model capabilities (Azure OpenAI / ChatGPT) have been integrated into vehicles using the MIB3 infotainment system, with new E³-architecture models featuring enhanced voice functions from the factory.

The AIME (AI Model Engine) backend program supports this development over multiple years, encompassing natural-language dialogue, empathic communication, and a comprehensive cloud-edge data pipeline. DXC Luxoft serves as the end-to-end delivery partner, collaborating as a joint product team with the client's engineers on the Azure platform (AKS, Azure OpenAI, Managed Identity, Azure Monitor, Azure DevOps).

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical vision across all three AIME work packages. You will translate Audi's product roadmap into concrete cloud-native, AI-first architectures and act as the primary technical authority in the joint product team. The role spans both high-level design and hands-on review, with regular presence in Ingolstadt.

Define and maintain the end-to-end system architecture across the LLM/RAG pipeline, voice I/O layer, Azure cloud backend, and in-vehicle edge components.
Own architecture decision records (ADRs) and ensure alignment between Audi engineers and the DXC Luxoft delivery team.
Lead solution design for Azure services: AKS, Azure OpenAI, Managed Identity, Azure Monitor, and Cosmos DB.

Project description

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du verantwortest die Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer bestehenden Visual Basic 6-Anwendungen und sorgst für höchste Codequalität.
Du optimierst Legacy-Systeme und bringst sie mit modernen Technologien wie Cloud-Plattformen und aktuellen Datenbanken zusammen.
Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Fehleranalyse, Debugging und die Migration historischer Software auf neue Plattformen.
Du arbeitest mit Source-Control-Tools wie Git oder SVN und unterstützt unsere DevOps-Teams bei Automatisierungs- und CI/CD-Projekten.
Du kommunizierst Projekte, Anforderungen und Lösungen souverän mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Stakeholdern.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Visual Basic 6 sowie Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise auch Kenntnisse in DevOps und Cloud-Technologien.
Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Software-Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich, mit exzellenten Studienleistungen.
Tiefgehende Expertise in VB6, SQL-Server, Source-Control (Git, SVN), sowie idealerweise in Automatisierung, Cloud-Plattformen und Containerisierung.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, starke Detailgenauigkeit, hohe Kommunikationskompetenz, Lernbereitschaft und dynamische Anpassungsfähigkeit.

Das kannst Du von uns erwarten:

Mobile Work: Arbeite flexibel an zwei Tagen pro Woche mobil und an 3 Tagen vor Ort.
Attraktive Standorte: An unseren Standorten erwarten Dich neben voll ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen auch regelmäßige Events wie Sommerfeste und Weihnachtsfeiern.
Langfristige Entwicklung: Bei uns bedeutet "Legacy" nicht Stillstand! Du bleibst auch nach Projektende Teil unseres Teams – mit individuellen Entwicklungspfaden und spannenden Perspektiven.
Gesundheit: Gesundheit ist für uns ein hohes Gut. In der hauseigenen Kantine gibt es jeden Tag eine Auswahl an leckeren und gesunden Gerichten und in unserem voll ausgestatteten Fitnessstudio heißen wir Dich in wöchentlichen Kursen gerne willkommen.
Mehr geht immer: Der Kindergarten auf unserem CGM-Campus in Koblenz unterstützt unsere Mitarbeitenden dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag noch flexibler zu gestalten. Wir halten außerdem Corporate Benefits, die Möglichkeit eines Jobrads, BAV, u.v.m für Dich bereit.

Vielfalt ist Teil von CGM!
Wir freuen uns unabhängig von Behinderung, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität auf Deine Bewerbung.

Überzeugt?
Bewirb Dich jetzt online mit Deinen aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inkl. Deiner Zeugnisse, Gehaltsvorstellung und nächstmöglichem Eintrittstermin).

We support our clients across Cloud, Modern Workplace, Business Applications, Data & AI, and Security
, and place a strong emphasis on our #PeopleFirst
culture.

Shape the Future of Cloud Transformation

Are you passionate about designing innovative cloud solutions that help organizations transform and thrive? Do you enjoy combining strategic architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership? If so, we invite you to join our growing Azure Platform team.

As an Azure Cloud Architect, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud platforms leveraging the full power of Microsoft Azure. You will help organizations accelerate their cloud journey while ensuring security, scalability, resilience, and operational excellence.

You act as a key interface between business, project management, development, operations, and external stakeholders, taking ownership of architectural decisions and providing technical leadership across projects.

Your Responsibilities

Design resilient, scalable, and secure Azure cloud architectures for enterprise customers.
Lead the design and implementation of Azure Landing Zones that establish a compliant and secure cloud foundation.
Architect and drive complex migrations of infrastructure, applications, and databases from on-premises environments to Azure.
Design and implement cloud-native solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, and modern Azure platform services.
Develop hybrid and edge cloud solutions that integrate Azure with existing enterprise environments.
Define cloud governance, security, identity, networking, and compliance standards.
Leverage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates) to automate deployments and platform management and Agentic development and deployment.
Collaborate closely with technical teams, project stakeholders, and executive leadership to ensure successful delivery.

Strong hands‑on experience in architecting, implementing, and operating Microsoft Azure solutions

You will work as part of an experienced engineering team, contributing to backend development, component design, performance, reliability and maintainability. The work is technically interesting because it combines complex business logic, long-lived enterprise software and the need to keep improving how we build and deliver functionality.

Most of the current product logic is written in APL, while we are increasing our use of C#/.NET and AI in new development, integrations, cloud enablement, and platform modernization. You do not need prior APL experience. You will work with experienced engineers across locations and have room to contribute to how we build, modernize and evolve the product.

Improve reliability and delivery through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and pragmatic engineering practices

Investigate technical issues, performance bottlenecks and bugs and help design sustainable solutions

Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to technical discussions within the team

Use Git-based workflows and work effectively in a continuous integration environment.

What We Are Looking For

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, mathematics, or a related field.
Solid engineering fundamentals: object-oriented design, architecture patterns, clean code, and pragmatic problem solving
Solid experience in C#/.NET (Core/Framework) and building backend systems (APIs, services, integrations).
Familiarity with APIs (REST/streaming patterns) and messaging concepts (e.g., service bus patterns).
Experience with Azure or cloud-based development is an advantage, but not a prerequisite 
Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, and Git-based workflows.
Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ability to work with complex business logic and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues .

APL READINESS

You don’t need prior APL experience. What matters is curiosity and willingness to learn. We provide training and a supportive environment to help you succeed, and SimCorp partly owns Dyalog APL, helping ensure the language remains actively maintained and relevant.

NICE-TO-HAVE

FinTech / regulated-industry experience.
Exposure to vector-based or functional languages (helpful for ramping up in APL).
Experience with Azure services or cloud-based development.
Experience mentoring other engineers or taking ownership of a component. 

Benefits

Base salary with annual bonus structure

Possibility to develop your career in an international environment
Professional training and courses provided by SimCorp
Polish language classes for foreign employees; German and English classes based on business needs
Integration events, volunteering initiatives and employee-led clubs

NEXT STEPS

. PANDORA’s Digital & Technology Hub in Warsaw
is a key part of the world’s largest jewellery brand, supporting millions of people in expressing their emotions through meaningful jewellery. As one of our fast-growing global locations, the Warsaw Hub plays a vital role in driving digital innovation, delivering scalable technology solutions and supporting our global transformation journey. Our teams work closely with colleagues across the globe, including our headquarters in Copenhagen, to shape the future of digital in retail and e-commerce.
Behind every great experience at Pandora is a robust digital foundation. Our engineering teams build and connect the systems that power our global ecosystem. You will join a dynamic environment where innovation meets reliability, and every integration is crafted with care. We value creative problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement—ensuring equitable opportunities for all.
We’re proud of our inclusive, people-first culture, guided by our values: We Care, We Dream, We Dare, We Deliver.

Role Summary:

The Engineer is a delivering member of a GOPT (Omni Operations Product Line) product team. You will build and support the integration solutions that keep Pandora's supply chain and distribution systems running, working within the technical direction set by your Lead Engineer and inside the agreed architecture and engineering standards. You will need good communication skills to work with your team, product colleagues and business analysts.
You will help deliver quality automated CI/CD pipelines, from requirements through test and behaviour driven development, whilst maintaining operational stability and high coding standards, together with supporting quality deployments, monitoring of the tech stack and overall production health.
The main outcome for this role is dependable delivery — well-tested, well-documented code shipped with minimal disruption to the business — and steady growth towards owning larger pieces of work independently. You will be part of our engineering chapter and will contribute to a DevSecOps culture towards build and run.

Key accountabilities System design and architecture Contribute to the design of integration solutions using .NET technologies and event-driven architecture, working to the technical approach set by the Lead Engineer and within the agreed architecture blueprint
Work with cross-functional colleagues (product management, architects, business analysts) to understand business requirements and translate them into technical tasks
Raise design questions, risks and unknowns early rather than resolving them alone

Integration development Develop and implement .NET-based integration components under the technical direction of a Senior or Lead Engineer, ensuring correct data flow across platforms, systems and applications
Write automated, reusable, testable and efficient code, applying Pandora engineering standards for performance, security and scalability
Participate actively in pair programming and code review — both submitting your work and reviewing the work of peers
Write and maintain unit and integration tests within the team's automated testing frameworks
Maintain technical documentation for the components you build — integration mappings, API specifications and troubleshooting notes
Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing integrations and propose them to the team

Deployment and operations support Prepare and execute deployments of your changes into non-production environments, and support production deployments alongside a more senior engineer
Provide post-deployment support and monitoring; join the on-duty engineering roster once onboarded, with a defined escalation path to Senior and Lead Engineers
Investigate and resolve incidents and defects affecting the components you work on, escalating promptly when an issue crosses system boundaries

Security and compliance Apply Pandora's secure coding practices by default — parameterised data access, input validation, no hardcoded secrets, least-privilege service configuration
Ensure changes comply with security standards, privacy regulations and company policies; raise anything unclear with the Lead Engineer or Information Security rather than working around it

4. What is needed to succeed 2+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, or a strong graduate profile with demonstrable project work
Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C#, .NET, JSON
Familiarity with REST APIs, web services and integration concepts; exposure to event-driven architecture and messaging platforms such as Kafka or Solace is an advantage
Practical experience with version control, automated testing and CI/CD tool chains
Exposure to supply chain, warehouse or logistics execution systems is an advantage rather than a requirement — domain knowledge is expected to be built on the job
Understanding of Agile delivery and a willingness to work in a build-and-run team model, including an on-duty rotation
Curiosity, and the willingness to ask for help early and to act on review feedback
English (business fluent)

You will align architecture decisions with business and IT strategy, define standards and guardrails, evaluate emerging AI technologies and help stakeholders understand trade-offs so that AI enablement is secure, scalable, compliant and strategically aligned.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations provides modern digital workplace services across Nordea. We are responsible for governance, compliance processes, platform enablement and operations related to Microsoft 365 services and supporting platforms. Our technology stack is broad and includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, agentic AI governance capabilities, integrations and custom applications for digital workplace. We add value by enabling Executives, Business, IT, Traders and Branches with dependable end-user services required for their daily work.

Our team is international, with colleagues based in Denmark, Finland and Poland. Your future manager is located in Warsaw.

Main responsibilities in this role:

Proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI platform enablement across Microsoft 365 and related cloud platforms in alignment with business and IT strategy.
Define technical guardrails for AI capabilities like M365 Copilot, Copilot Agents, Co-work
Design and architect agentic AI solutions and frameworks, including SharePoint Agents, Declarative Agents, Copilot Studio, custom/pro-code agents and Agent 365-enabled scenarios.
Define tenant-level platform controls, admin settings, enablement policies and technical review criteria.
Work with other team on environment strategy, DLP policies, Entra identities and AI governance.
Translate risk, security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical platform architecture and design controls.
Maintain architecture documentation, reference patterns, technical decision records and platform readiness requirements for new Microsoft 365 AI capabilities.
Proactively develop, guide and govern architectural standards, principles, reference patterns and best practices to reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility and enable business capabilities.
Analyze stakeholder requirements and maintain an overview of the current Microsoft 365 application, integration, identity and infrastructure landscape, including gaps that must be addressed through architecture roadmaps.
Build consensus and commitment among architects, platform teams, governance functions and business stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, target picture and implementation priorities.
Guide and advise stakeholders on architectural issues and implementation choices to ensure solutions are technically sound, supportable and aligned with Nordea standards.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks and tools to support strategic technology decisions and future platform direction.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are a strong AI and Microsoft 365 architect who can combine platform ownership, cloud architecture, security thinking, strategic architecture discipline and product mindset. You enjoy defining scalable guardrails, making technical decisions transparent and helping business and maker teams understand what is possible, allowed and supportable. You can communicate complex concepts in clear and understandable ways, drive consensus across stakeholders and contribute to architecture evolution that reduces complexity, cost and risk while improving agility and business capabilities.

Your background and skills include:

Strong AI, Microsoft 365 and enterprise architecture experience across enterprise-scale environments.
Good understanding of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 admin capabilities.
Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Awareness of broader enterprise AI platforms such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, including how they may affect enterprise AI architecture, integration, security, governance and platform strategy.
Experience designing and architecting agentic AI solutions, frameworks, reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem or Azure Machine Learning.
Have experience with Microsoft Entra Suite, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Power Platform governance or Graph connectors.
Understand Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, agent registry.
Have experience with secure connectors, APIs or knowledge integration
Experience designing secure platform services, enterprise integrations or governance-driven technology enablement models.
Understanding of identity, permissions, Conditional Access, DLP, audit, compliance and operational control patterns.
Ability to create architecture documents, decision frameworks, diagrams, technical roadmaps and implementation guardrails.
Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to drive strategic architecture discussions, facilitate decision-making and build consensus among senior stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
Experience developing and governing architecture principles, standards, best practices, roadmaps and target-state documentation across one or more architecture domains.

It would be ideal if you also:

Have experience operating platform services in a regulated enterprise environment.
Hold relevant certifications in AI, cloud architecture or enterprise architecture.
Have experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

This role is open in Łódź, Warsaw, Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model, combining office collaboration with flexible remote work.

What We Offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

jobs.title: Liferay Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Lead to build a B2B eCommerce platform for a leading pharmaceutical brand, and to lead the engineers building it alongside you.

This is a coding role first. You'll spend most of your week in the codebase, setting the technical standard by writing the hardest parts yourself and reviewing everything else. You'll work to the architecture set by our Technical Architect and turn it into working software, leading a distributed engineering team and working alongside WPP's managed service team who run and support the platform in Liferay.

What You'll Be Doing

Write production code. Liferay customisation, backend services and integrations, with the complex and high-risk work landing on your keyboard
Lead a distributed engineering team day to day, owning technical delivery through the sprint
Run code review and set the quality bar in the codebase, through standards, testing and pairing rather than documents
Break the architecture down into buildable work, and challenge the design where implementation reality says it won't hold
Own the build and release pipeline, environments and branching strategy
Debug and fix the problems nobody else can, across Liferay, integrations and infrastructure
Make sure what you build can be run, monitored and supported by a managed service team at agreed service levels
Support technical service transition, including runbooks, operational acceptance criteria and monitoring requirements
Act as technical escalation for the managed service team on complex incidents and root cause analysis
Own the technical debt backlog in the codebase and get remediation into the sprint, not just onto a list
Work directly with product owners, QA and the client's technical team at working level, in refinement, demos and technical clarification

What We Want From You

Strong hands-on Java engineering. You're coding now and you want to stay that way
Proven Liferay DXP development experience. OSGi modules, Service Builder or client extensions, headless and REST APIs, fragments and workflow
Commerce experience, on Liferay Commerce or a comparable platform. Catalogues, pricing, channels, carts and order flow
Solid integration engineering. REST, messaging, enterprise integration patterns and error handling in anger
Confident with relational databases, query performance and data modelling
Practical cloud experience, and CI/CD pipelines you've built and maintained yourself
Experience leading engineers through code review, pairing and technical direction rather than line management
Experience building solutions that are handed into, or run by, a managed service or application support team
Observability, logging, monitoring and alerting treated as part of the build
Clear written and spoken English, and technical documentation other engineers can actually use
Comfortable in a distributed, multi-location team across UK and India

If you know some of this, even better

Liferay certification, or contribution to the Liferay community
Experience delivering into validated or regulated environments. GxP, CSV or data residency
Event-driven architecture and streaming platforms
Caching strategies at scale, at Liferay and CDN layer
Elasticsearch or OpenSearch tuning
Prior experience of a blended change and run model

You will collaborate with our UK project team, so we’ll need you to be available until 18:00 PL

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

We offer net hourly rate for B2B
cooperation ranging from 159 - 206 PLN
, dependent on your skills and experience.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.

We empower your Brains
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.

And we champion Courage
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

Learn more about us on our LinkedIn page, visit our YouTube channel and follow us on Instagram WPP Poland.

Please note that this job is a full-time position located in Poland, but the selection process will be conducted in English.

Please send over your CV in English.

How We Use AI In The Recruitment Process

To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact the outcome of the interview process

In compliance with Polish regulations, VML Enterprise Solutions is committed to fostering a transparent and ethical work environment. We encourage reporting of any potential irregularities or misconduct. For detailed information on our whistle-blower policy and reporting procedures, please refer to our dedicated document.

At WPP Enterprise Solutions

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™

To find out more, visit enterprisesolutions.wpp.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including business needs, experience, level of responsibility and qualifications.In addition to the salary range provided, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' well-being and professional growth. While specific details may vary by agency, typical benefits often include: private medical care, professional development opportunities, training programmes and flexible working arrangements (where applicable). WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

Act
to deliver.
Disrupt
to grow.
Team up
to win.

B2B contract: 12 750 - 22 000 PLN + VAT

The project and the team

We are looking for a Java Software Engineer to join a strategic network automation initiative focused on accelerating the onboarding of network device features into an enterprise automation platform.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Lead to build a B2B eCommerce platform for a leading pharmaceutical brand, and to lead the engineers building it alongside you.

This is a coding role first. You'll spend most of your week in the codebase, setting the technical standard by writing the hardest parts yourself and reviewing everything else. You'll work to the architecture set by our Technical Architect and turn it into working software, leading a distributed engineering team and working alongside WPP's managed service team who run and support the platform in Liferay.

What You'll Be Doing

Write production code. Liferay customisation, backend services and integrations, with the complex and high-risk work landing on your keyboard
Lead a distributed engineering team day to day, owning technical delivery through the sprint
Run code review and set the quality bar in the codebase, through standards, testing and pairing rather than documents
Break the architecture down into buildable work, and challenge the design where implementation reality says it won't hold
Own the build and release pipeline, environments and branching strategy
Debug and fix the problems nobody else can, across Liferay, integrations and infrastructure
Make sure what you build can be run, monitored and supported by a managed service team at agreed service levels
Support technical service transition, including runbooks, operational acceptance criteria and monitoring requirements
Act as technical escalation for the managed service team on complex incidents and root cause analysis
Own the technical debt backlog in the codebase and get remediation into the sprint, not just onto a list
Work directly with product owners, QA and the client's technical team at working level, in refinement, demos and technical clarification

What We Want From You

Strong hands-on Java engineering. You're coding now and you want to stay that way
Proven Liferay DXP development experience. OSGi modules, Service Builder or client extensions, headless and REST APIs, fragments and workflow
Commerce experience, on Liferay Commerce or a comparable platform. Catalogues, pricing, channels, carts and order flow
Solid integration engineering. REST, messaging, enterprise integration patterns and error handling in anger
Confident with relational databases, query performance and data modelling
Practical cloud experience, and CI/CD pipelines you've built and maintained yourself
Experience leading engineers through code review, pairing and technical direction rather than line management
Experience building solutions that are handed into, or run by, a managed service or application support team
Observability, logging, monitoring and alerting treated as part of the build
Clear written and spoken English, and technical documentation other engineers can actually use
Comfortable in a distributed, multi-location team across UK and India

If you know some of this, even better

Liferay certification, or contribution to the Liferay community
Experience delivering into validated or regulated environments. GxP, CSV or data residency
Event-driven architecture and streaming platforms
Caching strategies at scale, at Liferay and CDN layer
Elasticsearch or OpenSearch tuning
Prior experience of a blended change and run model

You will collaborate with our UK project team, so we’ll need you to be available until 18:00 PL

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

We offer net hourly rate for B2B
cooperation ranging from 159 - 206 PLN
, dependent on your skills and experience.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.

We empower your Brains
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.

And we champion Courage
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

jobs.title: .Net utvecklare
jobs.description:
Hej! Jag heter Emelie 👋 och är konsultchef på Softronic. Jag letar just nu efter erfarna .NET-utvecklare som kombinerar stark teknisk kompetens med förmågan att förstå kunden och problemet vi faktiskt ska lösa.
Hos oss får du arbeta hands-on med allt från modernisering av stora verksamhetskritiska .NET-system till allt från nyutveckling i Azure – och samtidigt påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval och hur vi utvecklar mjukvara.
Det här kommer du att göra

Utveckla moderna och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar i C# och .NET
Arbeta med systemdesign, arkitektur, API och integrationer
Lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med kund och team
Använda AI-verktyg aktivt i utvecklingsarbetet – från analys och implementation till test och kvalitetssäkring
Bidra till hög kvalitet och bra leveranser genom hela utvecklingsprocessen
Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till att både team och kollegor utvecklas

Teknikstacken varierar mellan våra uppdrag, men du kommer ofta möta moderna versioner av .NET, Azure, CI/CD, integrationer och distribuerade system.
Vi tror att du

Har minst 6 års erfarenhet av professionell .NET-utveckling
Är riktigt trygg i C# och .NET
Har erfarenhet av större eller komplexa system
Har ett stort teknikintresse, håller dig uppdaterad och är nyfiken på nya tekniker, verktyg och arbetssätt
Använder AI som en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete
Kan självständigt driva tekniska frågor och föra arbetet framåt
Är bekväm i kunddialog och kan förklara tekniska vägval, ställa rätt frågor och utmana när du ser en bättre lösning
Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Bonus om du har erfarenhet av Azure, cloud-native, eventdriven arkitektur, tekniskt ledarskap eller säkerhets- och verksamhetskritiska system.
Varför Softronic?

För att du får vara utvecklare på riktigt – men sällan bara kodare.
Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och ofta med verksamhetskritiska system som behöver fungera, utvecklas och hålla över tid. Som senior utvecklare får du både djupdyka tekniskt och påverka lösningen, från tekniska vägval till hur den skapar värde hos kunden.
Softronic är stort nog för att ta ansvar för hela team och långsiktiga åtaganden, men tillräckligt nära för att du som individ ska kunna påverka. Och med många samhällsviktiga kunder får du möjlighet att bygga teknik som faktiskt används och gör skillnad.
Självklart har vi också kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet till kompetensutveckling.
Nyfiken?

Då vill jag gärna prata med dig.
Du behöver inte kunna bocka av varenda punkt ovan. Om du är en erfaren .NET-utvecklare som känner igen dig i beskrivningen – skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig så berättar jag mer.
/ Emelie Mirhagen
Konsultchef, Softronic

jobs.description:
Som senior .NET utvecklare hos oss får du arbeta med CM1, en ledande SaaS-tjänst som hjälper företag att motverka penningtvätt. Du kommer att jobba i ett engagerat produktteam, där du får ta ansvar, utvecklas och bidra till lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för våra kunder och samhället.

Hos oss kommer du att

Arbeta med förvaltning, vidareutveckling och support av vår SaaS-tjänst CM1
Arbeta med konfiguration, datainsamling och felsökning i tekniska miljöer
Samarbeta tätt med utvecklare, arkitekter, test, support och produktteamet för att lösa problem och utveckla tjänsten
Vara delaktig i kravställning samt hantera och följa upp ärenden i Jira
Vara en viktig del i ett agilt team som arbetar enligt SAFe

Vi tror att du har

Eftergymnasial utbildning inom data‑ och systemvetenskap eller annan relevant utbildning
Minst 8 års erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemutveckling med fokus på backend (.NET)
Ett strukturerat och ansvarstagande arbetssätt samt förmågan att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra
Erfarenhet av kundansvar med fokus på kunddialog, behovsanalys och löpande support.
God kommunikationsförmåga samt mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.

Kunskap inom:

C# .NET
Relationsdatabaser, SQL Server
Web API / REST

Extra plus om du har erfarenhet av:

Javascript, React
TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Storybook
ITIL och/eller arbete enligt etablerade supportprocesser
SAFe Scrum
AML, KYC eller arbete inom bank och finans
UX Design, UI Ramverk, Figma
Powershell

Vad du får hos oss

Ett sammansvetsat team med hög kunskapsnivå och stark laganda
En trygg anställning i ett stabilt bolag med kollektivavtal och goda förmåner
En varierad roll där ingen dag är den andra lik
Möjlighet till hybrid arbetsplats
Individanpassad karriär‑ och kompetensutveckling

Om CM1 & Softronic

CM1 är en marknadsledande SaaS‑tjänst inom AML och ett dotterbolag till Softronic AB som är en trygg och etablerad arbetsgivare sedan 1984. Tillsammans hjälper vi våra kunder att utveckla säkra och effektiva digitala tjänster som förenklar människors arbete och bidrar till ett mer hållbart samhälle.

På Softronic jobbar vi med teknik som gör gott i samhället. Hos oss är arbetsplatsen en energigivande del av livet, där gemenskap, kunskapsdelning och balans är självklara inslag. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud & Data)
jobs.description:
Humblebee is a digital service studio in Sweden. We build digital products with ambitious companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a cloud and data profile to join our product teams, where business, design and tech sit at the same table.

Why this role exists

Software engineering has changed. AI went from a feature you bolt on to a material you build with. That means knowing what to build, getting the data in order, and making the thing survive contact with production and real users.
We’re looking for breadth, and for someone who doesn’t need to be led. You see what needs doing, you say it out loud, and you get it done.

What you’ll be doing

You might be the spearhead: one engineer covering everything a client needs. You might work in a duo with a service designer, where the two of you cover each other’s blind spots. You might sit in a multidisciplinary team with engineers, designers and business-minded colleagues, sometimes ours, sometimes the client’s.

The mix shifts with the assignment. The work could include:

Sitting with clients to understand their business, then turning that into something you can build and ship.
Mapping how work actually gets done, and finding where AI saves real hours instead of looking clever.
Setting up complete AI flows, from data source through model and tooling to the interface people use, and the numbers that prove it pays off.
Building web and product features end to end, from data model to interface.
Designing data flows: getting data out of the systems it’s stuck in, cleaning it, and making it useful.
Building and running AI features that people rely on, such as retrieval, search, agents, recommendations and automated workflows, with evaluation and guardrails in place.
Working with cloud platforms and infrastructure as code so what we build can be deployed, monitored and handed over.
Taking prototypes to production, and being honest about which ones shouldn’t get there.
Using AI tools in your own work, and helping the rest of us get better at it.
Explaining trade-offs, assumptions and limits to people who don’t write code.

Is this you?

You’re a strong engineer first. You’re curious about how a business makes money, not just about the stack. You’d rather ship a small thing that works than a big thing that demos well. AI helps you move fast, and you still own what comes out: it has to hold up a year from now, for whoever picks it up next.

You likely have:

8+ years building and running software in production, ideally client-facing.
Solid experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, and with infrastructure as code.
Practical experience with data: pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar is a plus.
Strong TypeScript, C#, Java or Python. We work mostly in the JavaScript/TypeScript stack, with .NET, C# and Java in some teams, and Python where it fits.
Hands-on experience putting AI into real products: LLM APIs, retrieval, tooling and agents, plus how you know whether it works.
A feel for CI/CD, observability and security, because someone has to run this after we hand it over.
Comfort in the room with clients, including the ones who don’t know what they want yet.
The ability to say no, kindly, when a client asks for the wrong thing.

We like T-shaped people: deep in something, useful across the whole. Nobody knows everything, and we don’t expect you to. We do expect you to feel responsible for the whole, and to be straight about where your edges are.

You are as important as your skills

We hire people as much for their human traits as for their skills. We like good humans around us. We work in the open, in design sprints, development sprints and workshops with clients, so we hire people who are empathetic, kind, patient and generous. We are Humblebee.

Before you apply, read this carefully

To help us find the right fit, we prioritise candidates on these criteria:
Engineering craft.
 You build software that’s secure, fast and still holds up a year later, and you can point to it.
Data and cloud.
 Real experience moving data around and running things in the cloud, not just reading about it.
Business translation.
 You can turn a vague business problem into a clear technical plan, and explain it back in plain language.
Finding the work.
 You spot the inefficiency the client has stopped noticing, and you can size the value of fixing it.
AI in practice.
 You’ve shipped AI features and can tell us what broke, what you measured and what you’d do differently.
Collaboration.
 You like multidisciplinary teams and you make the people around you better.
Growth mindset.
 You share what you learn and help improve how we work.

Tell us about concrete projects. What was the business problem, what did you build, what changed as a result. Outcomes beat tech lists.

Good to know

This position is full-time, based in our Gothenburg office with a hybrid working model (part office, part home). A Swedish work permit is required. We don’t offer relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.
Humblebee is a multi-lingual company, so please write your application in English.

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. !

Mentoring and Coaching Team Members: You will guide them in resolving complex technical issues and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement

Could you be our new colleague?

Leda och delta i behovsanalys, kravarbete och workshops där verksamhetens processer omsätts i genomförbara lösningar och teknisk arkitektur.
Välja lämplig plattform och lösningsdesign utifrån användningsfall, data, säkerhet, förvaltning, skalbarhet och kostnad.
Bygga, konfigurera och driftsätta avancerade agenter i Copilot Studio, inklusive autonoma agentflöden, multi-agentlösningar och parent-child-arkitekturer.
Integrera agenter med Dataverse, SharePoint, Teams och kundens verksamhetssystem genom färdiga eller egna connectors och öppna standarder som MCP.
Bygga flöden i Power Automate och appar i Power Apps när lösningen behöver hämta, uppdatera eller skicka information i andra system.
Säkerställa att lösningarna följer kundens behörighetsmodell och relevanta krav på säkerhet, styrning och livscykelhantering.
Arbeta med användnings- och kostnadsuppföljning, förstå prismodeller och optimera agenternas tokenförbrukning och totala driftkostnad.
Etablera en hållbar förvaltningsmodell med tydligt ägarskap, miljöstruktur och ansvar efter leverans.
Utbilda, coacha och stötta verksamhetsnära utvecklare och andra kundteam som ska bygga och förvalta egna agenter.
Följa upp lösningarnas användning och kvalitet efter lansering och förbättra dem utifrån verkliga behov och resultat.

Plattformar och teknik

Tyngdpunkten ligger i dag på Copilot Studio och Power Platform. Våra kunder verkar samtidigt i flera tekniska ekosystem, och därför vill vi att du över tid kan arbeta plattformsoberoende och hjälpa kunden att välja rätt verktyg för rätt behov.

Du behöver inte kunna alla plattformar från start. Det viktiga är att du kan fördjupa dig i Copilot Studio och samtidigt vill förstå skillnaderna mellan exempelvis Microsoft 365 Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, Gemini Enterprise, ChatGPT Enterprise och Claude. När lösningar behöver samverka mellan plattformar använder vi öppna standarder som MCP och A2A.

Kvalifikationer

Om dig

Du har byggt agenter som används av verkliga användare och vet att produktionssatta lösningar behöver följas upp, förbättras och förvaltas. Du kombinerar teknisk höjd med verksamhetsförståelse och kan förklara komplexa vägval på ett tydligt sätt.

Du arbetar självständigt i kunduppdrag, är trygg med att leda workshops och vågar rekommendera ett annat angreppssätt när det ger bättre effekt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.

Kvalifikationer

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att bygga och produktionssätta avancerade agenter i Copilot Studio.
Erfarenhet av Power Automate och Power Apps i produktionslösningar.
Kunskap om Dataverse, datamodellering och integrationer.
Erfarenhet av integrationer mot SharePoint, Teams och verksamhetssystem med färdiga eller egna connectors.
Förståelse för säkerhet, behörigheter och styrning av agentlösningar.
Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till lösningsdesign, implementation och förvaltning.

Erfarenhet av Copilot Studio i produktion är ett krav. Övriga kvalifikationer kan vägas upp av annan relevant erfarenhet.

Extra meriterande

Autonoma agenter, multi-agentlösningar, parent-child-arkitektur och agentorkestrering.
MCP, A2A eller andra standarder och mönster för integration och samverkan mellan agenter.
Styrning och förvaltning av Power Platform och Microsoft 365, exempelvis miljöstrategi, DLP, Managed Environments, behörighetsmodeller och livscykelhantering.
Agentutveckling på andra plattformar, exempelvis Gemini Enterprise, OpenAI Agents SDK, ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude eller Agent Development Kit.
Azure AI Foundry, Azure Functions eller annan kodbaserad utveckling som komplement till lågkod.
ALM i Power Platform, inklusive lösningar, pipelines, miljöer och versionshantering.
Erfarenhet av att utbilda eller coacha verksamhetsnära utvecklare i Copilot Studio och Power Platform.
Förståelse för prismodeller, tokenekonomi, FinOps och kostnadsoptimering av AI- och agentlösningar.
Utrullning och styrning av Microsoft 365 Copilot i större organisationer.
Relevanta certifieringar inom Microsoft eller Google Cloud.

Rollen och uppdraget

Uppdrag där lösningar går från idé till produktion och långsiktig förvaltning.
En kombination av teknisk specialist, lösningsarkitekt, rådgivare och utbildare.
Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerade agentlösningar över flera tekniska plattformar.
Inflytande över hur vi utvecklar Forefronts erbjudande och arbetssätt inom agentisk AI.

Du blir en del av vårt Productivity & Collaboration-team, där du arbetar nära andra specialister inom digital arbetsplats och AI. Runt dig finns också kollegor inom Data & Analytics, Cloud & Security och andra kompetensområden. Tillsammans kan vi ta helhetsansvar när en lösning berör exempelvis data, identitet, behörigheter, integrationer eller molnarkitektur.

Vi lovar dig!

Sveriges härligaste kollegor.
Kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling genom uppdrag, kurser, certifieringar och kunskapsdelning.
Möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken inom agentisk AI.
Ett nära sammanhang med andra specialister, du står inte ensam i komplexa uppdrag.
Samarbete i tvärfunktionella team inom Productivity & Collaboration, Data & Analytics, Cloud & Security och andra kompetensområden.
En organisation där du får vara både teknisk specialist och rådgivande konsult.

Om Forefront Group

Forefront Group är din partner för affärsdrivande transformation. Vi vet att teknik skapar möjligheter och människor skapar förändring. Sedan 2008 förenar vi djup teknisk kunskap med strategisk höjd för att skapa hållbar förflyttning för våra kunder. Våra kunder ger oss ett NPS på 97. Forefront Group består av fem bolag: Forefront Consulting, Forefront Accelerate, Forefront Amplify, Forefront Act och Forefront Ignite, som adresserar olika delar i våra kunders förändringsresor. Med runt 500 specialister är vi rustade att leverera på vårt löfte: Delade visioner. Större ambitioner.

jobs.title: Specialist Solutions Architect Databases, AGS-EMEA-Europe North
jobs.description:
Description

Are you passionate about helping customers build database and cloud solutions? Come join us !

At Amazon, we've been investing deeply in building the right solutions that allow you to derive the most value from your database infrastructure. AWS is looking for a specialist solutions architect for our Database team, who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) helping customers to design complex solutions. As part of the team, you will work closely with Europe North customers across all industry verticals to enable large-scale use cases and drive the adoption of advanced AWS services. You will interact with other Solution Architects in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AWS.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and trustworthy support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Key job responsibilities

As a key member of the AWS Europe North Specialist Solutions Architecture team your work will include:

Working closely with our product and field teams and 3rd party model providers, you will help enable new capabilities for our customers to develop and deploy data workloads on AWS infrastructure
Design best in class database infrastructure solutions for all stages of customer and product lifecycles.
You will have the technical depth and business experience to deploy database and data strategies.
Partner with SAs, Sales, Business Development and Service teams to accelerate customer adoption and revenue attainment.
You will also work closely with account teams, research scientists, and product teams to drive model implementations and new solutions.
Thought Leadership - Evangelize and share best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.
Act as a technical liaison between customers and the AWS teams to provide customer driven product improvement feedback.
Develop and support an AWS internal community of related subject matter experts.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Hybrid Work

We value innovation and recognize this sometimes requires uninterrupted time to focus on a build. We also value in-person collaboration and time spent face-to-face. Our team affords employees options to work in the office every day or in a flexible, hybrid work model near Amazon offices.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of specific technology database domain area experience
Deep knowledge and experience on at least one commercial relational database (Oracle, SQL Server, IBM2), or open source database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB).
Familiarity with AWS technology
BA/BS degree or experience in lieu

- Deep knowledge and experience on at least one commercial relational database (Oracle, SQL Server, IBM2), or open source database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB).

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of non-relational databases such as mongodb, couchdb, redis
Technical Communication Skills; able to bridge the gap between business outcomes and technical requirements
AWS Certifications

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
