jobs.title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
CSQ427R155

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The Impact You Will Have

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What We Look For

6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
Documentation and white-boarding skills.
Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
Travel to customers 20% of the time
Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Experienced Solution Architect - Cloud, Solna
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of cloud-based API solutions? Join PostNord in Stockholm as an experienced Solution Architect and help build digital services that make a real difference.

At PostNord, technology and social responsibility come together to create digital solutions used by millions of people every day. As an experienced Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our digital future. We offer a collaborative, forward-looking environment where innovation is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work has a meaningful impact.

What We Offer You

A strategic role with the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions and the design of future-ready system support.
Work with clear social relevance, contributing to logistics solutions that support people, businesses, and society.
A value-driven workplace that prioritizes wellbeing, flexibility, and sustainable work-life balance.
Strong opportunities for professional development, including sponsorship for cloud certifications.
A hybrid way of working, with access to a newly renovated office in Solna.

What You Will Do With Us

You will join Sender Solutions within Customer Solutions at PostNord Group IT. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Booking API team and other teams across Sender Solutions to define architecture that meets today’s business needs while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities. Our solutions must meet high expectations for reliability, scalability, and efficiency, supporting both our customers and our long-term technology strategy.

Your role in brief

Shape the design and architecture of digital shipping solutions in close collaboration with the tech lead, product owner, and colleagues in the team.
Spend part of your time contributing hands-on as a system developer in the Booking API team, maintaining deep solution knowledge and staying closely connected to the team’s day-to-day work.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of large-scale solutions and integrations with complex dependencies.
Represent Sender Solutions in cross-area architecture forums, working closely with tech leads across the area.
Support product owners and teams in dialogue with major customers.
Drive innovation and continuous improvement to deliver solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

,

You Will Join a Skilled Team Of Around Ten Developers Working Across Both Back-end And Front-end Development. You Will Work Closely With The Team’s Product Owner, And Your Immediate Manager Will Be Annika Dahlström. The Team Uses Technologies Such As

AWS Microservices / Serverless.
NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript / Java
DynamoDB, Postgres, SQS, IAM, OAuth2, Fargate, S3, Elasticsearch, to name a few.
Swagger, Grafana, GitHub, XML/JSON, CI/CD

We are an engaged and ambitious team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Most of the team works from our office in Solna, with additional developers based in the Philippines. We apply a hybrid working model, with at least 60% of working time spent at the office. For this role, we would welcome a Solution Architect who can be on site more frequently to support close collaboration. We also offer flexible working hours.

More About You

You are an experienced architect with solid expertise in cloud technologies, system development, and API development. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and thrive in a role where you guide, inspire, and support your team. You have an academic degree in IT, or equivalent practical experience, and communicate fluently in both Swedish and English. Experience from the logistics industry is an advantage, as is an understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, can be applied to create business value.

Above all, you are collaborative, strategic, and customer-focused. You communicate clearly and adapt your message to different audiences and levels of technical understanding.

About Us

We move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

If you have any questions or concerns, please email emina.delkic@postnord.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med stort inflytande över hur framtidens lösningar inom Casino utvecklas. Vi söker en Principal Engineer som drivs av tekniskt hantverk, gillar att lösa svåra problem och vill bidra till att utveckla både system och människor omkring sig.

Casino är ett av ATG:s mest teknikintensiva områden. Här möts moderna backendlösningar, externa spelplattformar, transaktionsflöden, regulatoriska krav och tjänster som behöver fungera dygnet runt. Samtidigt är vi ett område i ständig utveckling där nya produkter, marknadssatsningar och affärsinitiativ kontinuerligt ställer nya krav på våra lösningar.

I rollen får du:

Utveckla och vidareutveckla tjänster och plattformar med höga krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och skalbarhet.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Creditsafe are expanding their Consumer Bureau team, an exciting new project aiming to have us enter the Consumer Credit Bureau space in the United Kingdom and eventually become a fully-fledged Consumer Reporting Agency. We’re looking for a Quality Engineer experienced in testing cloud-native software systems.

WHO WE ARE

Privately owned and independently minded, at Creditsafe, we are guided by values of customer-focus, trust, respect, and a willingness to try new things. For over 20 years, these values have shaped a culture of growth, innovation, and support, where our team members build successful, long-term careers.
With a diverse team spread across 25 offices in 14 countries, we value collaboration, learning, and problem-solving together. We have been featured twice in The Sunday Times' '100 Best Companies to Work For' and continue to prioritize well-being, career growth, and inclusion.
Our continued success has made us the most used business data provider in the world and one of the industry’s strongest growing business intelligence providers. Today Creditsafe has 23 offices across 3 continents serving 110,000 customers from SMEs to enterprise businesses.

THE TEAM

This opportunity is to join an Agile team of Software, Data and Quality engineers who are responsible for two - one productionized and one upcoming – big data projects. These projects process hundreds of GB a day in massive ELTL ingest, person-centric matching, and sub-second-serving batch and near-real-time processes.
The wider Quality Engineering community within Creditsafe work together in driving a culture of quality into the teams acting as knowledge experts on quality. We test throughout the lifecycle and believe that the whole team is responsible for the quality of our deliverables. We implement intelligent automation and are proponents of thinking critically about the features developed by our teams.

YOUR ROLE

You will validate data correctness across every layer of the stack: ingest, transformation, warehouse, and API. You will write SQL to interrogate millions of rows, build Python test suites that run against cloud infrastructure, and work directly with engineers and analyst to trace data issues from source to serving.
You will collaborate closely with our sister Data Analytics, and product teams, from the beginning stages of development, offering input on system design and testing strategies and ensuring our feature output matches their expectations and demands.
This is a hybrid position, requiring attendance in the office for 50% of the working week, in line with our hybrid work policy.

YOUR TOOL STACK

SQL. You'll write queries daily.
Python. PyTest, automation frameworks, data validation scripts
Pandas (or Spark/Polars). For dataset analysis and comparison.
AWS. Our stack includes Redshift, S3, S3Tables (Iceberg), DynamoDB, Aurora (Postgres), Step Functions, Airflow, Lambda, ECS, Glue, among others. You don't need to know all of them, but experience with any AWS data services (or equivalent in Azure or GCP) is a strong start.
API testing tools. Postman, Bruno, or similar.
Locust (or k6/Gatling/JMeter). For load and performance testing against data APIs and pipelines.
Git.
Azure DevOps. Boards, pipelines, repos, test plans.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Data Pipeline Testing: Build and maintain automated tests for data pipelines from ingest all the way until serving layer. Validate record counts, schema integrity, transformation logic, and cross-source consistency.
Data Validation: Verify correctness, completeness, and accuracy across Redshift, Aurora, S3, and DynamoDB. Trace individual records through the full pipeline when something doesn't add up.
API Testing: Test search and lookup APIs against expected data outcomes, not just status codes, but whether the right records come back with the right values.
Performance Testing: Design and run load tests against APIs and data pipelines using Locust or similar tools. Identify bottlenecks, validate SLAs, and ensure the system handles production-scale volumes.
Early Involvement: Join refinement sessions, challenge acceptance criteria and flag gaps before code is written.
Automation: Build test suites in PyTest that run in CI/CD. Integration tests against real AWS infrastructure, not just mocks.
Troubleshooting: When a pipeline produces wrong results, you find where and why. Clear reports, reproducible queries, root cause analysis.

We will support your learning and provide resources to help you grow in this role.
WHAT YOU BRING
Experience: Proven experience testing data systems, pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, not just web applications.
SQL: Good SQL skills. You can write joins, procs, and aggregations to validate data across tables.
Python: Good Python for test automation, scripting, and data analysis.
Cloud: Familiarity with AWS data services (Redshift, S3, DynamoDB, Aurora) or an equivalent cloud stack.
Analytical Mindset: You look at a dataset and spot what's wrong, not just confirm what's right.
Automation: Experience integrating test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Performance: Experience with performance and load testing tools (Locust, k6, Gatling, or similar) is desired.
Communication: Ability to explain data issues clearly to engineers and product owners.
Leadership: Experience mentoring junior engineers is a plus.

WHY CREDITSAFE
IC ladder with teeth. Staff and Principal are a destination, not a waypoint - with scope, comp and influence that genuinely match the title.
Written design culture. Anything non-trivial gets an RFC. Decisions are recorded. We disagree in documents, not in meetings.
Real operability. We run what we build. No hand-offs to a separate ops team.
Pragmatic agile. Teams own their own process. We optimise for shipping, not ceremony.
Customer-first. Our focus is on making work that adds value to our clients first. Stability, freshness, durability, trust – non-negotiable.
Leadership you’ll want to work with. Engineering leadership is technical, present, and will back your calls.

Benefits
Competitive Salary.
Company Laptop
Bonus Scheme.
25 Days Annual Leave (plus bank holidays).
Hybrid working model.
Healthcare & Company Pension.

We are committed to providing a welcoming, supportive environment. Creditsafe is an equal opportunities employer that values diversity. Please contact us if you need any assistance with your application.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Network Capacity Services, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable solutions for network capacity planning and optimization. Collaborate with network engineers, finance, supply chain, and operations teams

As NLM software engineer, you will spend time working with network owners looking for opportunities to add more safety, speed and automation into their processes. Equipped with this knowledge, you will translate business requirements into technical requirements, architect and design new features to help our customers fulfill their business requirements. NLM is a vital team that ensures that AWS Network can grow and keep up with the ever growing customer demand for larger and more reliable networks. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer, Amazon Foundational Security Services
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Our team is looking for a highly motivated Systems Development Engineer in Amazon Security who will raise the security bar by delivering industry-best security services. You should be somebody who enjoys inventing and simplifying around complex security challenges, obsesses over the customer experience, and feels strongly about delivering results. You should be passionate about solving security hurdles in innovative ways. We do not desire to simply produce good software here at Amazon Security... we want to produce disruptive, industry-leading innovations.

Key job responsibilities

Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers and customers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud and the Amazon retail site. The Amazon Security team owns security for all of these services offered by Amazon Security, including EC2, S3, and many others, as well as the security of our global retail sites. This team is an EU-based Operations team, integrated with Software Development teams, supporting Amazon Foundational Security Services, to provide our customers with secure by default security services. We dive deep into security technologies such as new access control design patterns, identity security services, access control, authorization, authentication, and life cycle management to support our customers as Amazon continues to scale and grow. We are looking for software professionals from diverse backgrounds, who are creative problem solvers, and passionate about delivering solutions that improve both user experience and security. We are a global team and have a culture of learning from each other. We don’t expect people to join our team knowing everything. We want people who are excited to learn, to challenge the status quo, and who are energized by building highly scalable and available systems on a global scale.

The EUSC Operations team runs a 24/7/365 operation, and on-call support will be required as part of this role. You would join the on-call rotation approximately once every 4–6 weeks.

Our team values work-life harmony. Being part of a 24/7/365 on-call rotation is an important aspect of maintaining operational excellence in this role, and we understand that striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. On-call rotations are structured to be manageable — occurring roughly once every 4–6 weeks — so that you can stay engaged and effective without feeling overburdened. We encourage members of the team to use personal time as needed to cultivate this balance and to promote a productive and well-balanced life — both in and outside of work.

This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state

Amazon has a fast-paced environment - “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” Our team works with users to design new security features, deploy software through large automated systems, and operationally support security software. You'll look for new approaches to automate fixes for operational issues and use Amazon Security services to solve design problems. Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. A healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. We offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and balanced life—both in and outside of work.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state

Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
Experience with AWS services

jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Aurora Control Plane, Aurora Control Plane
jobs.description:
Description

Come join the growing RDS Aurora Serverless Control Plane team, innovating on behalf of our customers on a service that:

Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud native databases for our customers freeing them from traditional database operations
Guarantees best-in-class availability and failover capabilities to sustain the world’s most demanding workloads
Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of a database cluster from creation to operation to scale-up, scale-out and fail-over

Amazon Aurora Serverless Control Plane does all this and more. Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native relational database which combines the scalability and performance of the best NoSQL databases paired with full compatibility to the most popular relational open source databases - MySQL and PostgreSQL. Amazon Aurora can store petabytes of customer data and can handle peaks of millions of queries per second. As one of the fastest-growing services at the core of the AWS Cloud and also one of the largest managed database services in our business, your engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses depend on the scale and performance of Amazon Aurora and its control plane to support their mission-critical workloads. We continue to believe it is Day 1 for the Amazon Aurora business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to Amazon Aurora.

As a Software Development Manager in this role, you will own a core part of the Control Plane charter, responsible for Aurora Serverless v2 and its wide array of enterprise features.

You will work in a highly collaborative, diverse and engaging environment that attracts talent and provides ample opportunities to grow and learn. You will have the freedom to shape how the team works and what mechanisms and processes you want to establish to achieve the teams and organizations goals and deliver results to our customers. This role gives you the opportunity to have an impact on the future of Aurora and its future growth.

In this role you provide technical direction and guidance to the team you are working with. Our engineers know that building a control plane to manage large scale cloud native databases is fun and challenging. It is not just any distributed system. It is a system orchestrating a distributed storage engine operating with petabyte scale data sets, real-time node failure detection mechanisms, multi-datacenter and cross-continent replication. You will coach junior and intermediate members of the team to become established contributors to our service by providing interesting and aspirational projects and mentoring them to successfully complete them. You will collaborate with senior engineers to work on large and complex features that have impact across different teams in the organization and high value for our customers.

You will also work directly with our customers to gather feedback and understand their use-cases. Together with the Aurora leadership this will help you to shape a vision for the team and define and align roadmap and deliveries with our product management. You will lead the delivery of new features both customer-facing and improving operational and technical efficiency of the solution. You will have an impact on our new offerings by taking advantage of your knowledge of industry trends and engineering tradeoffs and your ability to listen and understand the customer. You will be a thoughtful steward of existing systems, appropriately challenging assumptions and driving change when necessary to allow us to scale for growth.

This is a hands-on position in which you will be asked to show ownership. If you are technically knowledgeable and a good collaborator and communicator that can lead with empathy for our customers and engineers, then this is for you. We don’t need you to be an expert in databases. You will have a chance to learn on the go. We rather appreciate curiosity and craftsmanship over knowledge in specific technologies. At the same time you will benefit from interacting with many of the talented people within AWS and they will help you improve and expand your management and technical skills on a daily basis.

Aurora is part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

The role encompasses people, product and project management together with technical leadership. As a manager within the team, you will have opportunities to set the teams’ roadmap, and to work closely with support teams, senior engineers and other managers within the Amazon Web Services (AWS) organization.
The position involves manager on-call responsibilities, one weekend every 3 months. We don’t like getting paged, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant and that our alarms are well calibrated. When we do get paged, we work together to first mitigate and then resolve the root cause so we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
Grow and foster talent from Junior to Senior devs on a daily basis
Establish mechanisms to efficiently run the team and help prioritize and balance the backlog
Work with PM and other engineering teams on roadmap strategy and prioritization
Share updates to the leadership team on the teams deliverables
Review designs and help shape the teams design documents
Manage and drive the operational ownership of the team

Team is focused on customer dev experience and often operates across the org, closely working with Aurora Serverless, Aurora Storage, Aurora Platform teams.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Making life accessible

iLOQ is an international company headquartered in Finland that offers intelligent locking systems and total access management solutions. We provide secure and efficient access to buildings and facilities. Our mission is to make everyday life easier with a diverse range of safe and sustainable products for individual buildings, large real estate complexes and critical infrastructure sites.

We reinvented the lock. iLOQ's self-powered digital locking and mobile access solutions work without batteries or mechanical keys, something nobody thought was possible until we did it. But the lock is only half of the story.

Behind every iLOQ lock is iLOQ 5 Series+. iLOQ 5 Series + is our modern, cloud-based, AI-enabled software platform which powers access management for buildings and large real estate complexes across the world. Locks, keys, apps and cloud services are all working as one system: this is where hardware innovation meets serious software engineering. Scalable backend services, security-critical design and a platform that keeps evolving with new AI-driven capabilities.

We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer
to join our Software organization in Oulu. You will design, develop and maintain the secure, reliable and scalable backend services at the core of iLOQ 5 Series+. This is a role for an experienced software professional who enjoys solving complex problems, takes ownership beyond writing code and wants to influence both technical solutions and the way software is developed.

What you'll do

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will work as part of a cross-functional software team and contribute throughout the software lifecycle.

You will:
Design, develop, test and maintain reliable, scalable backend services and APIs for our cloud-based platform
Take end-to-end ownership of services from design and implementation to release, monitoring and continuous improvement
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical solutions
Explore and apply AI-assisted development tools in a secure and responsible way
Review code and develop automated tests, supporting high standards for security, quality and maintainability, and contributing to efficient CI/CD practices
Investigate and resolve complex technical issues
Contribute to the modernization and continuous development of our software architecture
Collaborating with Product Owners, Software Architects, Test Engineers and other stakeholders, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

What you'll bring

To succeed in this role, we expect you to have:
Relevant degree (Bachelor or Master)
Several years of professional experience in backend software development, including designing and implementing APIs and backend services
Strong skills in C# and .NET or comparable backend technologies
Experience with cloud technologies, preferably AWS, and a solid understanding of microservice architectures and distributed systems
Experience working with relational databases and data-driven applications
Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD and modern software development practices
An understanding of software security, maintainability and operational reliability
The ability to analyze complex problems and turn them into clear, sustainable solutions
A proactive and collaborative working style with strong communication skills, including professional written and spoken English

We consider experience in the following areas an advantage:
AWS services and cloud-native application development
Event-driven architectures and asynchronous communication
Service monitoring, logging and observability
Secure software development or access management solutions
High-availability or business-critical systems
Working with software solutions that interact with physical products or devices

What you'll get

You will build products that end up in buildings all over the world and ease the everyday lives of our customers. You will have real responsibility and freedom to operate without big corporation bureaucracy. We ensure you’ll have room to grow professionally in a fast-growing international company.

We offer you a workplace within a collaborative and forward-thinking company culture, friendly and skilled colleagues, proper onboarding, and a solid benefits package: bonus program, full lunch benefit, extensive occupational health care with an annual dental check, life insurance, plus regular team and company events.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and all employees are treated with respect. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply and join us in promoting an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Are you the person we are looking for?

We are expecting your application by October 14th at the latest. Please note that we might be reviewing candidates and conducting interviews during the application process and filling the position as soon as the right person has been found.

Could iLOQ hold the key to your next success story? Come and find out.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning AI possibilities into scalable real-world solutions? We do.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join Vincit and help our customers turn AI from hype into real business value.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong business mindset, working across software development, AI architecture, and customer collaboration. You’ll help customers identify where AI creates real value and design solutions that are both technically solid and commercially meaningful.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the code while also helping customers and teams make the right technical and architectural decisions. You’ll work closely with clients, designers, software engineers, and data experts to shape AI solutions that scale beyond proof-of-concepts and deliver measurable impact.

You know you’ve succeeded when customers clearly understand the value of AI, solutions make it into production, and your work creates meaningful outcomes for both the business and its users.

What is the job like, really?

Our customer base and projects are broad and diverse, ranging from startups to globally operating enterprises, and from early-stage AI experiments to large-scale production solutions. You'll work in both advisory-focused engagements and hands-on delivery projects where Vincit takes full responsibility for the solution.

Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities

☘️ Building AI solutions –
designing and implementing production-grade AI applications, integrations, and agentic workflows together with development teams

☘️ Acting as a technical lead –
ensuring technical quality, clarity, and scalability throughout the delivery lifecycle

☘️ Designing scalable architectures –
creating technical blueprints and solution architectures for modern AI and cloud-native applications

☘️ Consulting customers on AI opportunities
– helping clients identify where AI can create genuine business value

☘️ Leading discovery and proof-of-concepts
– facilitating workshops, technical discovery sessions, and validating new ideas quickly

☘️ Supporting sales and business development
– shaping proposals and acting as a trusted technical expert in customer discussions

☘️ Translating complexity into business value
– communicating AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences

☘️ Sharing knowledge and mentoring others
– supporting colleagues across engineering, design, and data disciplines

What are we looking for? 🔍

You’ll do well in this role if you enjoy solving real business problems with technology. You’re comfortable moving between hands-on development, architectural thinking, and customer discussions, and you know how to translate technical possibilities into practical outcomes.

You’re also curious by nature and excited to keep learning – whether that means experimenting with the latest AI capabilities, exploring new cloud services, or finding better ways to build scalable AI solutions.

Your background

🎯 Strong software engineering background, ideally in web development, cloud-native applications, or distributed systems

🎯 Strong experience designing and building AI-powered applications or solutions

🎯 Experience with modern agentic AI patterns, workflows, and development practices

🎯 Experience working with customer-facing projects or consultancy environments

🎯 Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and their AI capabilities

🎯 Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, or similar technologies

🎯 Ability to combine technical expertise with business understanding

🎯 Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences

🎯 Full professional proficiency in Finnish

It’s a Strong Plus If You Have

🎯 Experience bringing AI or agentic AI solutions from proof-of-concept into production

🎯 Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, or other modern AI platforms

🎯 Certifications in Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud technologies

What's in it for you?

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is worth considering:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects –
from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core –
work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem –
as a Microsoft Solutions Partner and SAP Gold Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working –
our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?

🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance –
shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay –
your monthly base salary reflects your experience and expertise. In addition, you’ll benefit from Vincit’s bonus model, personnel fund, and transparent salary weeks

🌟 Comprehensive benefits –
including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities –
develop your skills through Univincity and shape your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Read inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities –
a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion –
we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our
People & Culture blog
and learn more about how we work in our
Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com.

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

P.S. Please note that if you live abroad and want to work with us, we need you to have the necessary permits for working in Finland.

At Vincit, we turn digital into business results by combining leading enterprise platforms, AI solutions, and human-centric design. We help our customers make the most of SAP, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud ecosystems, embedding AI capabilities across their business operations and services.

We believe that extraordinary things are created together. That’s why we’re on a mission to create better Mondays – for our people, our clients, and our planet. Join us and become part of a community of top professionals across different areas of IT, united by curiosity, empathy, and a drive to build things that truly matter.

Etsimme Solution Area Architectia!

Solution Area Architectina
vastaat Elisan toimittamisen, talouden ja tukiprosessien sovellusalueiden arkkitehtuurista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet liiketoiminnan, IT:n ja toimittajien rajapinnassa varmistaen, että järjestelmät, integraatiot ja toimintamallit tukevat liiketoiminnan tavoitteita sekä tulevaisuuden tarpeita.

Liityt 10 hengen asiantuntijatiimiin, joka vastaa näiden sovellusalueiden kehityksestä. Roolissasi ohjaat kehityskokonaisuuksia, osallistut kehityshankkeisiin ja edistät uusien ratkaisujen käyttöönottoa yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Samalla tuot uusia näkökulmia ja teknologiamahdollisuuksia liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.

✅ Odotamme Sinulta

Taustaa ratkaisu- tai integraatioarkkitehdin tehtävistä sekä kykyä IT-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen.
Näyttöjä ERP-ratkaisujen uudistamis-, käyttöönotto- tai transformaatiohankkeista.
Ymmärrystä talous- ja toimitusketjun hallinnan prosesseista sekä niiden kehittämisestä.
Osaamista ERP-järjestelmistä, erityisesti SAP S/4HANA- tai Microsoft Dynamics 365 -ympäristöistä ja niiden keskeisistä integraatioista.
Kyky toimia tehokkaasti liiketoiminnan, IT:n, toimittajien ja muiden sidosryhmien välisenä yhteistyön mahdollistajana.
IT-järjestelmien ylläpidon prosessit, mukaan lukien järjestelmien budjetointi, elinkaaren hallinta ja tietoturva.

jobs.title: M365 AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5931

Welcome to Group Technology, where we pride ourselves on engineering solutions and direct Nordea’s transformation by providing a holistic technological view and structured understanding of the bank, and its surrounding environment to enable the Customer Vision and the Business Strategy.

We are looking for a M365 AI Platform Architect to join our team Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations service domain. In this role, you will proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI. While the primary focus is on Microsoft 365 AI capabilities, the role should also understand how other enterprise AI platforms, such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, may influence Nordea’s broader AI architecture landscape, integration patterns, governance guardrails and technology decisions. You will align architecture decisions with business and IT strategy, define standards and guardrails, evaluate emerging AI technologies and help stakeholders understand trade-offs so that AI enablement is secure, scalable, compliant and strategically aligned.

Nordea is a place where traditions meet tomorrow. We're not just a bank, we're a tech employer on a mission to evolve finance securely and responsibly. Together, we impact millions of people’s daily lives by ensuring they can access our solutions anytime, anywhere, while safeguarding their personal data and wealth. Join us in making an impact on the banking industry.

About Our Team

Content Management in End User Engineering & Operations provides modern digital workplace services across Nordea. We are responsible for governance, compliance processes, platform enablement and operations related to Microsoft 365 services and supporting platforms. Our technology stack is broad and includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, agentic AI governance capabilities, integrations and custom applications for digital workplace. We add value by enabling Executives, Business, IT, Traders and Branches with dependable end-user services required for their daily work.

Our team is international, with colleagues based in Denmark, Finland and Poland. Your future manager is located in Warsaw.

Main responsibilities in this role:

Proactively drive the vision, target architecture and technical roadmap for AI and agentic AI platform enablement across Microsoft 365 and related cloud platforms in alignment with business and IT strategy.
Define technical guardrails for AI capabilities like M365 Copilot, Copilot Agents, Co-work
Design and architect agentic AI solutions and frameworks, including SharePoint Agents, Declarative Agents, Copilot Studio, custom/pro-code agents and Agent 365-enabled scenarios.
Define tenant-level platform controls, admin settings, enablement policies and technical review criteria.
Work with other team on environment strategy, DLP policies, Entra identities and AI governance.
Translate risk, security, privacy and compliance requirements into practical platform architecture and design controls.
Maintain architecture documentation, reference patterns, technical decision records and platform readiness requirements for new Microsoft 365 AI capabilities.
Proactively develop, guide and govern architectural standards, principles, reference patterns and best practices to reduce complexity, manage risk, improve agility and enable business capabilities.
Analyze stakeholder requirements and maintain an overview of the current Microsoft 365 application, integration, identity and infrastructure landscape, including gaps that must be addressed through architecture roadmaps.
Build consensus and commitment among architects, platform teams, governance functions and business stakeholders on architectural trade-offs, target picture and implementation priorities.
Guide and advise stakeholders on architectural issues and implementation choices to ensure solutions are technically sound, supportable and aligned with Nordea standards.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks and tools to support strategic technology decisions and future platform direction.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are a strong AI and Microsoft 365 architect who can combine platform ownership, cloud architecture, security thinking, strategic architecture discipline and product mindset. You enjoy defining scalable guardrails, making technical decisions transparent and helping business and maker teams understand what is possible, allowed and supportable. You can communicate complex concepts in clear and understandable ways, drive consensus across stakeholders and contribute to architecture evolution that reduces complexity, cost and risk while improving agility and business capabilities.

Your background and skills include:

Strong AI, Microsoft 365 and enterprise architecture experience across enterprise-scale environments.
Good understanding of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID and Microsoft 365 admin capabilities.
Good understanding of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
Awareness of broader enterprise AI platforms such as Gemini, Claude or similar GenAI solutions, including how they may affect enterprise AI architecture, integration, security, governance and platform strategy.
Experience designing and architecting agentic AI solutions, frameworks, reference architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, the Microsoft Copilot ecosystem or Azure Machine Learning.
Have experience with Microsoft Entra Suite, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Power Platform governance or Graph connectors.
Understand Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, agent registry.
Have experience with secure connectors, APIs or knowledge integration
Experience designing secure platform services, enterprise integrations or governance-driven technology enablement models.
Understanding of identity, permissions, Conditional Access, DLP, audit, compliance and operational control patterns.
Ability to create architecture documents, decision frameworks, diagrams, technical roadmaps and implementation guardrails.
Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to drive strategic architecture discussions, facilitate decision-making and build consensus among senior stakeholders, architects and delivery teams.
Experience developing and governing architecture principles, standards, best practices, roadmaps and target-state documentation across one or more architecture domains.

It would be ideal if you also:

Have experience operating platform services in a regulated enterprise environment.
Hold relevant certifications in AI, cloud architecture or enterprise architecture.
Have experience with Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

This role is open in Łódź, Warsaw, Helsinki. We work in a hybrid model, combining office collaboration with flexible remote work.

What We Offer

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

People are driven by many different factors. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 15/10/2026. Please note that we will proceed with potential candidates already during the application period.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

Preliminary CV selection
Phone conversation with the recruiter
Online interview with the hiring leader
Background check

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

Only for candidates in Finland:
A security clearance will be performed for the person selected for this position.

Please include permit for processing personal data in CV as following:

In accordance with art. 6 (1) a and b. Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) hereinafter ‘GDPR’. The administrator of your personal data is: Nordea Bank Abp operating in Poland through its Branch, address: Aleja Edwarda Rydza Śmiglego 20, 93-281 Łodź. Your personal data will be processed for the recruitment processes in Nordea Bank Abp. You have a right to access your personal data, right to rectify and right to delete. Disclosing the personal data in the scope specified by the provisions of Polish Labour Code from 26 June 1974 and executive acts are mandatory. Providing personal data is necessary to conduct the recruitment processes. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team’s mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently.

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

About The Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership
Drive the technical strategy across the Privacy Center, the Unified Privacy Platform, and Privacy Operations and Intelligence
Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions
Deliver simple, self-service experiences for consent and communication preferences, Right to be Forgotten (RTF), Right to Information (RTI), and Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs)
Turn emerging privacy and regulatory requirements into standardized platform capabilities instead of one-off product implementations
Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation
Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage teams so privacy actions are traceable, retryable, auditable, and correctly reflected back to users and operators
Provide architectural guidance for distributed systems that manage sensitive user choices, policy evaluation, orchestration, secure data delivery, reporting, and immutable audit trails
Partner with recruiting to build a diverse and inclusive team, attracting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

We’re excited about you because you have…

A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of experience in people management leading backend or platform teams
8+ years of industry experience
Extensive experience as an engineer or engineering leader in a fast-paced, platform-focused development environment
Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems, service application programming interfaces (APIs), policy or rules engines, workflow orchestration, state machines, data-lifecycle systems, or audit architectures
Preferred experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or regulatory systems, including concepts such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), data-subject rights, retention, deletion, and legal holds
The ability to translate ambiguous legal, policy, and product requirements into clear platform boundaries, reusable abstractions, and executable roadmaps
Strong product sense and the ability to partner effectively with Legal, Product, Design, Security, Data, Marketing, Support, and engineering teams across multiple brands and geographies
A growth mindset—you are eager to expand your skills, raise the quality bar, and build enduring systems in a rapidly changing environment

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

jobs.description:
Do you want to build advanced AI agents that solve real business problems, not just prototypes? Are you excited by combining software engineering and AI into production-ready solutions?

As we grow our Data & AI practice in Finland, we are looking for AI Engineers to strengthen our technical capabilities and help deliver innovative solutions for our clients. Building on our successful project delivery, we are expanding our team and welcome applications from both early-career and experienced professionals.

You will join a global Data, Analytics & AI community helping leading organizations turn data into business value through data strategy, engineering, advanced analytics, AI, and intelligent automation.

About The Role

You thrive at the intersection of software engineering, business, and AI. You enjoy building modern applications and turning emerging technologies into production-ready solutions that create business value. You are equally comfortable understanding client needs and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

In This Role, You Will, For Example

Build, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications, AI agents, and cloud-native solutions
Design scalable architectures and integrate applications across frontend, backend, cloud, and enterprise environments
Develop intelligent software solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, MCP, and agentic AI capabilities
Work directly with clients to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
Identify and help shape opportunities where AI can create measurable business value for clients
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver end-to-end solutions from concept to production
Present technical solutions and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders

The exact focus and responsibilities of the role will be tailored to your experience level and interests.

We Are Looking For

Background in software engineering through professional experience, studies, and/or personal projects, with experience or a strong interest in building software solutions
Experience in working across frontend, backend, and cloud environments
Experience in designing, integrating, and consuming APIs
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS) and infrastructure-as-code concepts
Exposure to Generative AI, LLM-based applications, or related AI technologies
Curiosity and a desire to continuously learn and experiment
Fluent communication skills in English (written and spoken), preferably also in Finnish and/or Swedish

Nice-to-have Qualifications Include

Hands-on experience with LLMs, reasoning models, AI agents, RAG, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph
Experience in building reliable AI agent workflows, including tool use, function calling, validation, and human-in-the-loop processes
Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, and tracing
Knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI practices
Experience working with clients and stakeholders, ideally in a consulting environment

What We Offer You

Steep learning curve & interesting projects: We combine deep technology expertise with strong functional and industry knowledge. You’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GenAI technologies and modern cloud platforms, helping clients solve complex business challenges. From designing AI agents to integrating LLM-powered capabilities into enterprise solutions, you will turn emerging technologies into measurable business value.
Personal & professional growth: We invest in our people. We support the development of your personal competencies and long-term career progression through regular development discussions, formal training, and hands-on project work.
Flexible work culture: We have a people-oriented culture where your work-life balance is supported with flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities. Our office located in the center of Helsinki provides a modern and comfortable working space when you work on-site.
Competitive compensation & benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package, including a performance-based bonus, coupled with a wide range of benefits.
Great team spirit: We focus on teaming also outside of project work through a variety of after-work activities and events together with your colleagues. We look forward to welcoming you to our collaborative and supportive team.

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. For us, diversity and inclusion are an important part of our employment proposition. We want everyone to fulfill their potential and be themselves, regardless of background. To learn more about us and our culture, you can check out our video and visit www.bearingpoint.com. You can also follow our latest news and daily life on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and blog.   

If this sounds like the next step in your career, join us!

We look forward to receiving your application by October 25th
. Please note that we will review applications and start interviews before the deadline. This is a permanent full-time position based in Helsinki.

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. Consulting covers the advisory business with a clear focus on selected business areas. Products provides IP-driven digital assets and managed services for business-critical processes. Capital delivers M&A and transaction services. BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 13,000 people and supports clients in over 70 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success. In Finland, we are focusing on Consulting and are located in the heart of Helsinki where our around 100 employees are based.  

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key focus areas – More innovation, More for our planet, and More for our people. To make sure we live that purpose, we’re steered by a set of values that bring our purpose to life and are the essence of our culture – We are easy to work with, We create lasting outcomes, We empower people to succeed. We are a strongly purpose & values-driven organization, both today and as we forge our way into the future. Learn more about our purpose and values here.

BearingPoint is a certified B Corporation, meeting high standards of social and environmental impact.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning AI possibilities into scalable real-world solutions? We do.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join Vincit and help our customers turn AI from hype into real business value.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong business mindset, working across software development, AI architecture, and customer collaboration. You’ll help customers identify where AI creates real value and design solutions that are both technically solid and commercially meaningful.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the code while also helping customers and teams make the right technical and architectural decisions. You’ll work closely with clients, designers, software engineers, and data experts to shape AI solutions that scale beyond proof-of-concepts and deliver measurable impact.

You know you’ve succeeded when customers clearly understand the value of AI, solutions make it into production, and your work creates meaningful outcomes for both the business and its users.

What is the job like, really?

Our customer base and projects are broad and diverse, ranging from startups to globally operating enterprises, and from early-stage AI experiments to large-scale production solutions. You'll work in both advisory-focused engagements and hands-on delivery projects where Vincit takes full responsibility for the solution.

Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities

☘️ Building AI solutions –
designing and implementing production-grade AI applications, integrations, and agentic workflows together with development teams

☘️ Acting as a technical lead –
ensuring technical quality, clarity, and scalability throughout the delivery lifecycle

☘️ Designing scalable architectures –
creating technical blueprints and solution architectures for modern AI and cloud-native applications

☘️ Consulting customers on AI opportunities
– helping clients identify where AI can create genuine business value

☘️ Leading discovery and proof-of-concepts
– facilitating workshops, technical discovery sessions, and validating new ideas quickly

☘️ Supporting sales and business development
– shaping proposals and acting as a trusted technical expert in customer discussions

☘️ Translating complexity into business value
– communicating AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences

☘️ Sharing knowledge and mentoring others
– supporting colleagues across engineering, design, and data disciplines

What are we looking for? 🔍

You’ll do well in this role if you enjoy solving real business problems with technology. You’re comfortable moving between hands-on development, architectural thinking, and customer discussions, and you know how to translate technical possibilities into practical outcomes.

You’re also curious by nature and excited to keep learning – whether that means experimenting with the latest AI capabilities, exploring new cloud services, or finding better ways to build scalable AI solutions.

Your background

🎯 Strong software engineering background, ideally in web development, cloud-native applications, or distributed systems

🎯 Strong experience designing and building AI-powered applications or solutions

🎯 Experience with modern agentic AI patterns, workflows, and development practices

🎯 Experience working with customer-facing projects or consultancy environments

🎯 Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and their AI capabilities

🎯 Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, or similar technologies

🎯 Ability to combine technical expertise with business understanding

🎯 Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences

🎯 Full professional proficiency in Finnish

It’s a Strong Plus If You Have

🎯 Experience bringing AI or agentic AI solutions from proof-of-concept into production

🎯 Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, or other modern AI platforms

🎯 Certifications in Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud technologies

What's in it for you?

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is worth considering:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects –
from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core –
work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem –
as a Microsoft Solutions Partner and SAP Gold Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working –
our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?

🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance –
shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay –
your monthly base salary reflects your experience and expertise. In addition, you’ll benefit from Vincit’s bonus model, personnel fund, and transparent salary weeks

🌟 Comprehensive benefits –
including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities –
develop your skills through Univincity and shape your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Read inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities –
a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion –
we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our
People & Culture blog
and learn more about how we work in our
Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com.

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

P.S. Please note that if you live abroad and want to work with us, we need you to have the necessary permits for working in Finland.

At Vincit, we turn digital into business results by combining leading enterprise platforms, AI solutions, and human-centric design. We help our customers make the most of SAP, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud ecosystems, embedding AI capabilities across their business operations and services.

We believe that extraordinary things are created together. That’s why we’re on a mission to create better Mondays – for our people, our clients, and our planet. Join us and become part of a community of top professionals across different areas of IT, united by curiosity, empathy, and a drive to build things that truly matter.
