jobs.title: Software Engineer – Renewable Energy Platforms
jobs.description:
Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that’s energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels, whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently – we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it and mend it.

About your team:

At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. We’re a global renewable energy trading company which helps move energy from source to use – powering businesses, homes, and societies as they transition to a new sustainable energy future. If the idea of working to create a sustainable energy future also moves you, we may very well be the right place for you.

Technology is central to how we move energy from source to use. As a Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve the platforms that support our renewable trading business while contributing to a major effort to bring multiple systems together into a single, long-term technology foundation. Working alongside skilled engineers and business experts, you will have the opportunity to influence both the solutions we build and the direction we take next.

About The Role

We are bringing together several platforms that have supported different parts of our business over many years. As we create a more unified technology landscape, we are investing in the teams that will build, evolve, and maintain these systems for the future. This creates an exciting opportunity for experienced developers to influence both the direction of our technology and the way we work together as engineering teams.

Depending on your skills, experience, and interests, you will either join an existing team where you can quickly contribute and learn from colleagues with deep domain expertise or become part of a team focused on shaping the next generation of our platforms. We carefully match new colleagues to the environment where they are most likely to succeed, supported by a structured onboarding programme, a dedicated buddy, and experienced colleagues who will help you build domain knowledge from day one.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead the design, development, and enhancement of backend services and APIs using .NET C#.
Drive architectural decisions that ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Build and enhance desktop applications using WPF while integrating systems through modern Web APIs.
Develop resilient cloud-native solutions using AWS, Kubernetes, messaging technologies, and modern database platforms.
Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, testing practices, and continuous improvement.

About You

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into reliable, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments where people challenge each other, share knowledge, and work together towards a common goal. While strong technical skills are important, we're equally interested in your curiosity, judgement, and ability to help others succeed.

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

Significant experience developing enterprise applications using .NET C#.
Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including cloud technologies, system design, and DevOps.
Proven experience designing distributed systems and making sound architectural decisions.
A passion for building maintainable, well-tested software with long-term sustainability in mind.
The ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders, alongside experience with technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Datadog, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.

Previous experience within energy trading is beneficial but not essential. Strong engineering capability, technical leadership, and a growth mindset matter far more than industry background.

About Centrica Energy

We are a leading energy trading and optimisation business, helping move energy from source to use across global markets. We trade power, gas, LNG, and environmental products, connecting producers, suppliers, and customers while helping make energy systems more flexible, resilient, and sustainable. We are Energy Movers by Nature, driven by our purpose of energising a greener, fairer future.

From eight offices across Europe, Asia, and North America, our teams combine market expertise, data, technology, and trading capabilities to help balance supply and demand, manage risk, and support the transition towards a more sustainable energy future. We are also one of Europe's largest renewable asset managers, with substantial renewable and flexible generation capacity under management.

Joining us means becoming part of an ambitious, international organisation where technology is central to everything we do. Together, we are building solutions that help power businesses, homes, and societies while creating the energy systems of tomorrow.

Why should you apply?

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.

https://www.morethanacareer.energy/centricaenergy

If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

jobs.title: Experienced Software Developer – Team Box Collab
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help modernize a product area at the heart of construction projects.

Dalux is growing, and we are looking for an experienced software developer to join our Box Collab team.

You will build software in our File Management product (Box) that enables communication and collaboration across construction stakeholders—for example, file comments, sharing, versioning, and review. This domain is widely used and deeply integrated across the Dalux product suite, so reliability, performance, and strong technical design are essential. In Box Collab, we foster an engaging, enjoyable work environment where people take ownership and accountability for outcomes. You’ll join a young, skilled team with strong opportunities to influence both product evolution and architectural direction.

Your role

As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will join a full-stack development team working closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks: helping make good technical decisions, improving the codebase and architecture, sharing knowledge, and raising the engineering standard around them.

Within Box Collab, there is a particular focus on strengthening and evolving the technical foundation of the product while continuing to deliver new functionality.

Your work can include:

Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end
Designing and implementing scalable, maintainable solutions
Contributing to architectural decisions and the technical direction of Box Collab.
Improving the structure of an established codebase and reducing technical debt
Helping evolve boundaries and modularity within the application
Sparring with and mentoring other developers
Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions
Bringing new ideas, technologies, and development practices into the team when they create real value

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

AI-assisted software development

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

The Box Collab team is already experimenting with how these tools can improve its day-to-day development work.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in that development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

Practical experience using AI as part of your development workflow is an advantage. More importantly, you should be curious about how these tools are changing software engineering and willing to continue evolving your own way of working.

Technologies we work with

Box Collab is a full-stack product area primarily built with:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
MSSQL
Elasticsearch

Our wider platform runs on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

What would make you a particularly strong match?

We are looking for an experienced software developer with strong technical fundamentals and the ability to influence the software around you.

For this particular team, we would especially value:

Str ong professional experience with C# and .NET
Strong DB management experience, including indexing strategies and query performance optimization.
Experience improving or modernizing established software systems
An understanding of Domain-Driven Design, modular architecture, or similar approaches to structuring complex applications
Experience mentoring or providing technical sparring to other developers
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and workflows

You do not need to match every point.

Technical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to make an established product better are more important than having worked with exactly the same technologies or architectural patterns before.

Product development at Dalux

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Developers are expected to understand the problem being solved and contribute to finding the solution – not simply implement specifications handed to them.

As an experienced developer, you will have an important voice in balancing user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart.

As an experienced developer, you can expect:

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to improve an established product and architecture
A healthy work-life balance, with a strong focus on a sustainable work week and no overwork culture.
Clear opportunities for professional and career growth.
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
A social workplace with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, Dalux develops user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

Interested?

If you are looking for a role where you can remain hands-on while gaining greater technical influence and helping evolve an established product and architecture, we would like to hear from you.

We recruit continuously as Dalux grows.

Join our Pizza & Beer event

Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

jobs.title: Mobile Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

What You'll Be Building

You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI
, allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

Some of the challenges you'll work on

Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity
Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas
Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices
Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments
Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

Our engineering culture

You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

We'd love to hear from you if you

Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field
Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

We are looking for a Solutions Architect to define and evolve the architecture, information management strategy and technology roadmap for Common Data Environment (CDE) ecosystem. The role will shape how project, design, construction, handover and operational information is governed, exchanged and consumed across ecosystem of consultants, contractors, service providers and delivery partners.

The successful candidate will establish architecture patterns, integration models, information structures and governance frameworks that enable trusted information exchange across multiple CDE, BIM, project delivery and enterprise platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise architect role: the architect must understand that the product is not merely software, but the lifecycle of project and asset information across organisations, systems and delivery stages.

Responsibilities

CDE architecture and strategy: Define the target architecture and technology roadmap for JTC's CDE ecosystem, balancing partner collaboration, construction digitalisation, BIM coordination, governance, interoperability, scalability and long-term maintainability.
Information architecture and governance: Define information structures spanning planning, design, construction, handover and operations, including metadata, classification, naming conventions, project structures, document hierarchies and information lifecycles.
Establish controls for information ownership, stewardship, permissions, approval states, retention, auditability and traceability, aligned with CDE principles and ISO 19650 information management practices.
Platform architecture: Design reusable patterns for document management, BIM coordination, workflows, collaboration, issue management, approvals, partner onboarding, information exchange and digital handover.
Ensure the architecture supports current and future CDE platforms without unnecessary vendor lock-in, while meeting standards for extensibility, scalability, resiliency, security and operational supportability.
Integration architecture: Define API strategies, event-driven patterns and interoperability standards connecting CDE, BIM, project delivery, asset management and enterprise systems.
Design information flows across Autodesk, Nemetschek, LeapThought, Bentley, Procore, Oracle Aconex and other technology ecosystems, including digital handover and long-term asset information management.
Technology leadership: Guide Product Managers, Business Analysts, Experience Designers and Engineering teams on solution design, architecture trade-offs, product evolution and technical debt management.
Collaborate with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud and platform engineering teams to ensure solution designs align with enterprise principles and controls.
Vendor and ecosystem management: Evaluate vendor capabilities, implementation approaches and product roadmaps; promote open standards, interoperability and informed capability expansion, consolidation or rationalisation.

Requirements

At least 8 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, platform architecture or large-scale systems integration.
Demonstrated experience delivering construction technology, project information management, CDE or BIM-related solutions.
Strong understanding of solution, enterprise, information, integration and platform architecture principles, including cloud-native application design.
Experience designing ecosystem-level platforms involving multiple products, stakeholders, organisations and delivery partners.
Proven ability to define architecture standards, reference architectures, integration models and technology roadmaps.
Practical experience with CDE architecture, BIM ecosystems, construction information management, project collaboration platforms, document management, revision control, digital handover or asset information management.
Strong understanding of how information is created, reviewed, shared, approved, transferred and reused throughout the asset lifecycle.
Working knowledge of ISO 19650 information management principles and multi-party information exchange between owners, consultants and contractors.
Strong stakeholder engagement and architecture governance capability, with the ability to balance business outcomes, governance requirements, technical constraints and long-term maintainability.

Preferred

Hands-on architecture, implementation or governance experience with one or more CDE, BIM, construction collaboration or project information management platforms, including Autodesk Construction Cloud, Autodesk Platform Services, Nemetschek solutions, LeapThought, Bentley platforms, Procore or Oracle Aconex.
Experience across multiple technology ecosystems, with the ability to establish adaptable and interoperable architecture rather than dependence on a single vendor.
Experience in construction technology, BIM collaboration, information management, digital delivery, design coordination, construction management and digital handover.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, API Management, event-driven architecture, microservices, enterprise integration, SaaS platform architecture, and identity and access management.
Knowledge of information governance, data governance, security architecture, compliance architecture, and audit and traceability controls.
Ability to evaluate emerging CDE, BIM, information management and construction technology solutions and recommend practical adoption approaches.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, IAM, Authorization Management
jobs.description:
Description

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

What do you know about protecting sensitive data? What about fine-grained access control (FGAC) on Big Data? Or attribute-based access control (ABAC) and context based authorization? What about catching bad actors that are abusing Amazon services? Or attacks that could potentially lead to a widespread data breach? Do you know how to generate activity-based intelligence (ABI) through anomaly detection?

In Security Products we build Access Policy Management systems to enable all Amazon teams to apply FGAC to their sensitive data. We build products that apply context based authorization to solve the problem of over-permissioning. We apply Machine Learning Techniques in our Monitored Access (MA) abuse detection program to preemptively detect and mitigate internal and external malicious actors. We do this to protect Amazon customer, seller, vendor and employee information across from constantly changing abuse actor behaviors and patterns.

In our newly created organization we have a rare opportunity to engage with multiple Amazon organizations and groups of experienced tech leaders to build products with impact at an impressive scale (hundreds of thousands of services).

We are looking for enthusiastic Software Development Engineers with strong analytical and problem solving skills, who will participate in full development cycle for mission critical systems. You will work with leading-edge technologies and tools, on innovative and sophisticated features, collaborate with your team and its leadership to drive key engineering and business decisions that will enhance the Amazon’s security posture. You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle, including design, implementation, documentation, testing and operations.

Key job responsibilities

Your work focuses on delivering software features and improvements to major portions of your team’s software. This is not just new software but often includes refactoring and deprecation work.
You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks. You bring clarity to problems and identify simple designs for solutions.
You design software solutions to enable new features or improve software. You may still require guidance from your team’s leadership to ensure your designs are in alignment with your team’s long-term architectural strategy.
You are a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle, including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment and maintenance of the team's software.
You are active in the code review process on your team, providing meaningful feedback to others, including those who are more senior.
You document what your team’s software does; how it is constructed, tested, and operated; how secure it is; and how it fits into the bigger picture. When new teammates join, you actively train them in these points.
Your work positively impacts the software quality, customer experience, and maintainability of your team’s product(s). You are starting to balance customer requirements with team requirements.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or other technical degree or related experience
Experience in computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis)
Computer Science fundamentals in algorithm design, problem solving, and complexity analysis;

Knowledge of professional software engineering practices & best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations;

Have previous experience in gathering business information and transform it in technical requirements. - Experience with secure systems and architecting applications that deal with sensitive information

Project description - VR-125264

Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

Skills

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

At Amazon, security and privacy are central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security and customer privacy across all of Amazon’s products and services.

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team. Our mission is to make encryption simple, scalable, and invisible for software builders across the company. We build the core services, libraries, and developer tools that enable thousands of engineering teams to securely encrypt and decrypt their data with minimal effort, allowing them to focus on building great products while meeting the highest security standards.

The work you do will have company-wide impact. You’ll work on challenging technical problems at scale, collaborate with experienced engineers, and help define the future of secure software development.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);

development.

native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.

Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.

Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE-I, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code - from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.

Key job responsibilities

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward
Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation
Build and maintain resilient distributed systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective
Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies
Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns
Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties
Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues

Basic Qualifications

Education Requirements (must meet one): Currently enrolled in Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or related STEM fields OR Completed Bachelor's or Graduate degree in specified fields
Expected graduation between October 2025 - September 2026, OR graduated within the last 24 months
Demonstrated experience with at least one general-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C++, C#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a team which has been announced as Top Employer for the third consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for a second year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the first time!

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.600 professionals in Greece, to experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are currently seeking highly motivated people for our Technology Consulting practice to work either in Athens or Patras, which is a leading provider of services to the financial industry and large corporate clients of all industries.

You will work in multi-disciplinary teams to provide a broad range of information technology-related services, such as IT strategy and architecture, IT implementation support, and software design/development. Team members include professionals with a variety of backgrounds, including excellent academic credentials in quantitative sciences, IT, engineering, business, and economics, as well as deep professional experience in Greece and abroad.

As an IT Professional, you will contribute technical insight to client engagements and internal projects, as well as supervise more junior members of the team, in Greece and abroad. In line with EY's commitment to quality, you will ensure that your work is of the highest quality.

Your Key Responsibilities

In-depth understanding of Object-Oriented design/programming, familiarity with commonly used design patterns (DI, Repository, Service, Mediator) and the SOLID principles.
Proven working experience in application development using the .NET Framework in C# (ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Web API, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework/Dapper).
Solid understanding of relational databases and experience working with at least one RDMS (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
Working knowledge of versioning and source control systems. Hands-on experience with Git is considered especially important.

Skills and attributes for success

Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor’s and preferably a master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology/Systems or other related field with strong quantitative focus.
At least 2 years of working experience as a .NET Software Engineer
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills in both Greek and English.

Ideally, you’ll also

What we look for

Experience with Azure cloud technologies and DevOps practices.
Experience with containers (Docker) and orchestration (K8S) services.
IT-related professional qualifications or certifications.

What We Offer You  

Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:

Developing your professional growth:
You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.
Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.
Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.
Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).
Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.description:
Cube RM is the leading global Tender Software company, empowering Life Sciences organisations to identify more business opportunities through the power of Data and AI. Our platforms leverage cutting-edge technology to capture key tender market data worldwide and transform it into actionable intelligence combined with seamless software automation and industry expertise to significantly increase tender process efficiency.

To further drive the provision of smart solutions and ensure effective utilisation of the vast amount of data collected, analysed, processed, and delivered as data products, we are expanding our engineering team and seeking a talented Backend Software Engineer to join our core team.

As a Backend Software Engineer at Cube RM, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development and enhancement of our software ecosystem, collaborating with the wider team to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions that meet and exceed the expectations of world-class organisations.

If you believe you are a strong fit for this role and innovation is your game, we would love to hear from you. Join our dynamic team and help drive transformative growth in the Life Sciences industry!

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust backend services and APIs aligned with business needs
Build and operate data pipelines that ingest public tender data from multiple sources and countries, with a focus on data quality, normalization, and monitoring
Develop and maintain resilient data processing and extraction components, using AI where it adds value
Manage, monitor, and optimize relational database operations for high-volume data workflows
Work AI-first using agentic coding tools such as Claude Code while owning the quality and correctness of delivered software
Build AI-powered capabilities and features into products and data processes
Participate in code reviews, including reviews of AI-generated code, and help maintain high engineering standards
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability
Troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, and deliver lasting fixes
Handle data securely and responsibly, including when working with AI tools
Collaborate with Product, AI, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver data products to clients

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years of professional experience as a software engineer, with a solid grasp of backend infrastructure and software design principles
Experience working with large datasets and data pipelines, ideally within a SaaS environment
Strong experience with C# and modern .NET
Strong experience with relational databases (SQL), including schema design and query optimization
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents in day-to-day development, with sound judgment on when to trust, verify, or rewrite their output
Understanding of RESTful API design and clean, maintainable architecture
Familiarity with Azure, including App Services, Service Bus, Functions, and Storage, or with a comparable cloud platform
Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, critical thinking, and analytical mindset
Clear communication, ownership of your work, and a collaborative approach
Curiosity about new AI tools and approaches, and the ability to learn quickly as they evolve

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Python for data processing, extraction, or AI integration work
Experience with message queues or event-driven architectures such as Service Bus or RabbitMQ
Experience with Elasticsearch or other search technologies, including vector or semantic search
Experience working with multilingual or unstructured document data
Prior experience in pharma, medtech, healthcare, or public procurement

Benefits

Competitive benefits package (Medical - Life Insurance, meal e-card)
Friendly working environment and several "work-office" perks (Advanced work/IT equipment, Welcome package, Wellness offerings)
Flexible work schedule (Hybrid model)
Access to training and support, so you'll never feel left on your own (e-training options, subsidized certifications)
Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and software/product development methodologies
Be part of several tech communities, as we support/participate into several meet-ups, both local and international

We are driven by technology and innovation, continuously evolving our proprietary platform to deliver seamless and engaging online entertainment experiences to our growing customer base.
We have our own proprietary platform which is a living organism of 150+ microservices and applications, most of them highly available. Our microservices' stack is .NET Core, SQL Server, RabbitMQ as a Message Broker and Redis for caching. We also use the ELK stack for logging, Kafka for event streaming and MongoDB.

At Novibet, you'll be empowered to take on meaningful challenges, develop your skills and contribute ideas that make a difference. Join us and become part of a global team where collaboration, innovation and continuous growth drive everything we do.

Building quality microservices in a web API approach using the latest version and features of C# (.NET 5+)

Mentoring and providing guidance to rest of the team members, fostering their professional growth
Staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies in the .NET ecosystem

University and/or Postgraduate Degree in a relevant field
Minimum 5 years of work experience as a Software Developer

Hands-on experience in C# .NET 5.+, WebAPI, Entity Framework, LINQ

English language (both verbal and written)

🚀Career Growth: Focused career development, performance management, and training opportunities
🏋️Free access to our in-house gym to keep you energized
🚗Alternative Transportation: Shuttle buses & Carpooling options
🌍Inclusive Environment: A welcoming, international, and multicultural team
🎉Engaging Activities: Exciting events, sports, and team-building activities

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

A Bachelor’s degree in one of the fields of Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field

Ideally, you’ll also have

What’s most important is that you’re dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. Above all, you will be working in one of the most recognized employers in Greece, as we have been awarded the Top Employers, Great Place to Work and Best Workplaces for Women awards for 2024.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (SMARTLINK IoT platform)
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a senior .NET developer who builds that backbone.

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . NET 10
and C#, with PostgreSQL
for domain data, Apache Kafka
for events, Redis
for caching and ClickHouse
for high-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with OpenTelemetry
.

We are building a new back-end, designed around domain-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.

In This Role, You Will

Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud-native .NET services that own their own data.
Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.
Shape the design upstream and raise the bar around you: turn requirements into a workable domain model during refinement, say so when something cannot be built cleanly, and lead through review and standards people actually follow.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Several years of hands-on C# and .NET back-end development, at a level where you own a service end to end and design the APIs others build on: contracts, versioning, and the discipline of not breaking your consumers.
A working grasp of domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Hands-on with PostgreSQL, including JSONB where the model has to stay flexible, and comfortable writing and reasoning about your own SQL.
Apache Kafka as architecture, not plumbing: producers and consumers, partitions and offsets, schemas and delivery guarantees, and the distributed reality around them - asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Container-based, cloud-agnostic development: Kubernetes (AKS / EKS / OpenShift), with containers and pipelines as part of how you build, test and ship.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Designing a domain model or a service landscape from the ground up.
ClickHouse or another columnar time-series store for high-volume telemetry, and Redis at scale.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
Your role

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.

You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.

As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.

You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.

You build the back-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.

Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.

To succeed, you will need

You have built back-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.

You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.

Must-have

C# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10): recent, hands-on experience building production-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
Azure: practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
REST API design and implementation: designing and consuming well-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
SQL databases: data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
Testing as part of development: unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.

Strong plus

Apache Kafka: consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
Graph databases: Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
Secure-by-default cloud development: managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
Observability: structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
Domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Microservice architecture: service boundaries, inter-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
Event-driven and message-based architecture: queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
CI/CD with Azure DevOps: YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

jobs.description:
Our client, a prominent organization in the transportation sector, is looking for an experienced developer to take ownership of designing and building high-quality software solutions. This role involves translating business ideas into reliable applications within a complex functional domain while ensuring maintainable and well-tested code.

Responsibilities

Design and develop secure, performant .NET Core Web APIs and software solutions.
Collaborate with solution designers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical implementations.
Take full ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complete software solutions.
Implement and maintain code quality using Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles.
Integrate backend APIs and handle offline/online data synchronization for mobile applications.
Set up and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments.
Contribute to the team's growth through knowledge sharing and a constructive professional attitude.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in .NET development, including LINQ, async/await, and security practices.
3+ years of experience with .NET Core Web API design and development.
3+ years of experience in Azure Cloud development, leveraging PaaS and event-driven patterns.
Proven experience with Unit Testing, Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles across multiple projects.

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem - commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert - so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet - flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.

You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.

You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution - what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.

jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.

Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

in Teilzeit (mind. 80%) oder Vollzeit

Was du bei uns bewegen kannst

Pionierarbeit & Standortscheduling:
Als technische Speerspitze gestaltest du das Wachstum von inovex in der Schweiz aktiv mit. Du verbindest technologische Glaubwürdigkeit im Pre-Sales mit nachhaltiger Projektdelivery und legst das solide Fundament, auf dem zukünftige Teams aufbauen.
Brücke zwischen Business-Vision & Code:
Du schliesst die Lücke zwischen Business-Bedürfnissen und Technologie. Vage Kundenideen und komplexe Anforderungen übersetzt du treffsicher in konkrete und funktionierende Softwarelösungen.
Hands-on Prototyping & Software Engineering:
Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt in der aktiven Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen und Systemarchitekturen direkt im Kundenprojekt. Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit baust du funktionale Prototypen sowie MVPs auf.
Pre-Sales & Strategische Beratung:
Du führst und/oder begleitest Kundengespräche und übersetzt Business-Visionen in pragmatische, machbare Softwarekonzepte. Du führst interaktive Discovery- sowie Architektur-Workshops durch und lieferst fundierte Aufwandsschätzungen.
Architektur-Standards & Agile Führung:
Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.

Wer gut zu uns passen würde

In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect & Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:
Fullstack-Engineering & Architektur-Expertise:
Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend- und Backend-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Spring Boot oder .NET / C#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD-Pipelines.
Cloud-Native & Modern Tooling:
Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless- oder Hybrid-Cloud-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.
Data & AI Grundlagen:
Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.
Beratungspersönlichkeit & Unternehmergeist:
Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.
Sprachkompetenz & Reisetätigkeit:
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Französischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.

Dein Team

In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das Schweizer inovex-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Schweizer Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland. Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort.

Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte. Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen.

Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig. Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

40-60%

Tools, Services and Infrastructure (TSI) develops and supports the tools, applications and infrastructure for the global SI B PRO R&D organization, owning the full lifecycle of the PLM/ALM toolchain used by 5,000+ end users, with 3,000+ tickets resolved per year and 100+ tools managed. Within TSI, Applications & Data Insights develops applications, integrations and data products, extending the ALM ecosystem with automation and AI. Our landscape includes:

IBM Jazz ALM for agile project management, requirements, test and system design — plus Report Builder and a large in-house extension portfolio (50+ Jazz plugins and custom tools)
Source code, build and quality tooling: Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, UrbanCode Deploy, build and test environments
R&D financial and business processes (Jedox-based budgeting and cost tracking)
Reporting and analytics: IBM Report Builder today, moving progressively to Power BI and Snowflake for Management Events , alongside KPI dashboards and data products

We use SAFe agile approach with local developers, remote team members and external suppliers in close cooperation. Beyond support, maintenance and continuous delivery, we train our users and maintain the documentation and knowledge base that keeps our services self-serviceable.

Your role

You will join our development team to further develop the tools above into user-centric, future-proof solutions, and you will contribute directly to extend and create plugins and tools, and infusing AI capabilities into the tool landscape (Jazz / WISPR / MCP integrations, Jazz Copilot).

Your New Responsibilities

You support the development of new features across the TI tool landscape, collaborating closely with experienced software engineers and participating in projects, change management and training for new technology implementations
Building on this, you contribute to the entire engineering cycle by assisting in requirements analysis, architecture and design, coding, deployment and ongoing support
In this context, you produce clean, efficient code to specification, integrate software components and REST-based interfaces, and help verify and deploy programs and systems
Additionally, you maintain and upgrade existing software, troubleshoot coding issues efficiently, and help fix defects to ensure application and plugin reliability
Complementing these tasks, you help create technical documentation for various audiences and contribute to the team wiki and knowledge base

Your Talents And Experience

You are currently enrolled in a Swiss university degree program in computer science, software engineering or a related field and have initial practical experience in software development
You have hands-on experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C# or .NET Core
You are familiar with web technologies and frameworks, including basic frontend development with JavaScript, HTML and CSS
You have knowledge of REST APIs and integration patterns, and are confident in using version control systems such as Git
You demonstrate a high level of analytical ability, learn new technologies quickly and work in a structured, thorough and independent manner
You have very good English and or German skills

Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
Opportunity to develop an international professional network
Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members

The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment - it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development.
